programme.title: False I.D.
programme.desc: The police superintendent interferes with the capture of a murder suspect.

programme.title: Fatal Vision
programme.desc: Toby struggles with PTSD after killing a suspect while the IIB attempts to stop an assassination.

programme.title: Too Many Cooks
programme.desc: NCIS agents from Washington, D.C., Los Angeles and Hawaii, in D.C. to attend the retirement party of a beloved Federal Law Enforcement Training Center professor, find themselves investigating his shocking suicide.

programme.title: Bridges
programme.desc: Parker discovers he's a victim of identity theft while investigating the unusual murder of a Navy ensign; Knight and Jimmy face hurdles in their relationship as their connection heightens.

programme.title: Big Rig
programme.desc: When an old pal of Torres' comes to him -- disheveled and bloodied -- for guidance amidst an undercover FBI operation and then disappears, NCIS helps track him down; McGee prepares to be a contestant on a popular game show.

programme.title: Evil Eye
programme.desc: In preparation for a role, a world-renowned actress shadows the NCIS team as they investigate a decapitation case.

programme.title: Old Wounds
programme.desc: Parker grapples with his emotions when a con man from his past turns up as a prime suspect in the murder of a navy officer.

programme.title: Unusual Suspects
programme.desc: NCIS investigates the death of a ride-share driver who was found after a car accident; Parker's dad, who is temporarily living with him, assists the team in their investigation.

programme.title: Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: The NCIS team jumps into motion to investigate who is responsible for a potential bioterror attack at a strip mall parking garage; Knight's father deals with a health scare while in Japan.

programme.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
programme.desc: NCIS works to solve the murder of a Marine private who appears to have been killed for helping an Afghan refugee; Jimmy navigates the pressure of parenting his teenage daughter, who is eager to go out on an unchaperoned group date.

programme.title: Head Games
programme.desc: The NCIS team digs deep to investigate a Navy lieutenant who's accused of trying to murder her husband but has no memory of the attack; Kasie navigates a potential medical scare.

programme.title: In the Spotlight
programme.desc: Agent Knight goes viral for saving a mother and child from a potentially fatal car accident.

programme.title: Second Opinion
programme.desc: NCIS works to solve the murder of a senator's daughter who has a rebellious reputation and large online following; Jimmy gets competitive with an old college rival.

programme.title: Kompromat
programme.desc: NCIS must investigate a string of Russian spy encounters that may be linked to a suspicious murder; Jimmy accidentally makes a confession that could change the course of his relationship with Knight.

programme.title: Black Sky
programme.desc: Agent Torres finds himself in prison as the team tries to stop an impending terror attack on U.S. soil.

programme.title: Heaven and Nature
programme.desc: McGee and Torres try to recover a stolen truck filled with toys for the Navy's annual Christmas drive; the truth about Parker's mother is finally revealed; Knight is tasked with tracking down a former member of the team.

programme.title: Her
programme.desc: Knight is given orders to hunt down and arrest Eleanor Bishop after the former member of the NCIS team is designated a wanted cyberterrorist.

programme.title: Army of One
programme.desc: When a desperate man barricades himself inside an ammo warehouse, Knight is the only negotiator he'll talk to, claiming she once saved him before; as explosives tick and trust frays, Knight clashes with the CID officer running the standoff.

programme.title: In Too Deep
programme.desc: A murdered drone pilot leads the team to a missing woman from McGee's past and a relationship he thought was long behind him.

programme.title: Algún Día
programme.desc: The NCIS team must help Torres when he puts his future at stake by confronting the man who tormented his family when he was a child.

programme.title: The Stories We Leave Behind
programme.desc: As NCIS mourns the loss of Ducky, the agents find comfort in working on one of his unfinished cases involving a woman whose father was dishonorably discharged from the Marines.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: When the NCIS team engages in Walk-a-Mile day to gain a new perspective on different departments, things take a turn when Kasie receives a distress call from a mysterious man.

programme.title: Left Unsaid

programme.title: Mind Games
programme.desc: Gregorio calls on her former behavioral science professor when the team's latest case matches one she studied during FBI training.

programme.title: The Assassination of Dwayne Pride
programme.desc: A journalist posts a scathing article documenting Pride's "reckless use of justice"; the team is concerned about the fallout from the piece and the confidential information revealed; Rita Devereaux tells Pride it is a coordinated attack on him.

programme.title: Checkmate, Part I
programme.desc: Pride assembles an off-the-books team to search for a loophole when he faces a grand jury indictment for abuse of power.

programme.title: Checkmate, Part II
programme.desc: Pride's teams uncover a sinister plot during the New Orleans Tricentennial Fleet Week celebration.

programme.title: See You Soon
programme.desc: While Pride fights for his life in the ICU, the team scours the city for the hit woman who attempted to assassinate him.

programme.title: Inside Out
programme.desc: The team searches for a former Irish Republican Army bomb maker who was smuggled into the city; they are joined by agent Hannah Khoury, Pride's replacement during his medical leave; Pride considers a new position within the agency.

programme.title: A'ohe Mea 'Imi a Ka Maka
programme.desc: On Halloween, Jerry and his friends search his childhood camp for evidence to a murder he witnessed as a boy; McGarrett investigates a little girl who drew pictures depicting the scene of a recent murder before it was discovered.

programme.title: Aia I Hi'ikua; I Hi'Ialo
programme.desc: McGarrett crosses the line and is arrested while investigating the death of his former SEAL buddy who died while making an emergency landing on an aircraft carrier; Adam returns to Oahu with devastating news about his marriage.

programme.title: Pua a'e La Ka Uwahi O Ka Moe
programme.desc: McGarrett investigates a cold case that his grandfather and the famous Honolulu detective Chang Apana worked on in the 1940s; McGarrett and Danny get ready for the opening of their restaurant.

programme.title: Lele Pu Na Manu Like
programme.desc: Grover's parents and brother arrive in Oahu for Thanksgiving; a thief is crushed to death by an empty safe.

programme.title: Mai Ka Po Mai Ka 'Oia'i'o
programme.desc: When a renowned urban vigilante is killed after making a citizen's arrest, the team delves into the world of superheroes and comic books to find the killer; Adam gets closer to finding out who killed his sister.

programme.title: Pio Ke Kukui, Pō'ele Ka Hale
programme.desc: After fighting off an assassin in his own home, McGarrett and Joe White flee to Montana to prepare for a battle against those exacting revenge for a past SEAL mission.

programme.title: Hala I Ke Ala O'i'ole Mai
programme.desc: Still reeling from the murder of one of their own, Steve and Catherine, along with Danny, Junior and some old friends, hunt down the killer; a bag of human bones discovered inside an abandoned storage locker goes missing.

programme.title: Ka Hauli O Ka Mea Hewa 'Ole, He Nalowale Koke
programme.desc: McGarrett and the team support Danny and Rachel by determining what happened when Grace gets into a life-threatening car accident; Tani helps Koa when his rehab patient goes missing.

programme.title: Ke Iho Mai Nei Ko Luna
programme.desc: Adam, Junior and Tani travel to the bottom of the Pacific Ocean when a murder takes place in a remote underwater lab -- and the killer may still be on board.

programme.title: Ikiiki i ka la o Keawalua
programme.desc: While investigating Flippa's friend's murder, McGarrett and Grover uncover a deadly plan by an extremist group on the Island; Grover has an emotional reaction to the case.

programme.title: Ho'opio 'ia e ka noho ali'i a ka ua
programme.desc: As a dangerous hurricane hits Oahu, Five-0 is tasked with protecting El Diablo, a captured serial killer who is being hunted by an assassin; Tani's civilian safety check during the storm turns deadly; Rachel and Charlie evacuate to Danny's house.

programme.title: Hapai ke kuko, hanau ka hewa
programme.desc: When the top salesperson for a beauty company pyramid scheme is murdered, the team sifts through a long list of possible suspects who would want her dead; Adam befriends a homeless man.

programme.title: E'ao lu'au a kualima
programme.desc: Junior is torn between his duties and his feelings for his former girlfriend when her new man is one of the culprits in a bank heist-turned-homicide.

programme.title: Ai No I Ka 'Ape He Mane'o No Ko Ka Nuku
programme.desc: Tani and Junior go undercover at a gym to track down a deadly batch of steroids; Danny and McGarrett work as bodyguards for Danny's high maintenance ex-mother-in-law, a famous romance novelist with whom he has never gotten along.

programme.title: Pupuhi Ka He'e O Kai Uli
programme.desc: The team investigates the murder of a window washer and finds that the victim is actually a renowned street artist; Grover and Adam look into the murder of a gambler; Junior helps his father when they are reminded of his sister's death.

programme.title: Ke Ala O Ka Pu
programme.desc: When the team must locate a girl who purchased a gun from a junkie, it discovers that the firearm, over the course of decades, has affected all the teammates' lives.

programme.title: Cold Storage
programme.desc: Toby and Michelle search for a killer suspected of taking national defense secrets.

programme.title: Buckle Up
programme.desc: Toby goes undercover to find a group of thieves posing as police officers.

programme.title: Witness for the Prosecution

When Wyatt unwittingly kills Shumway's mentor, a master magician, she flees to Mexico. Furious, Wyatt hires private detective Alex Ross (Russell Crowe) to capture the gorgeous witness to his crime. But, after Ross locates Shumway, he finds himself beguiled by her growing prowess as a magician -- and by the potency of her feminine charms.

programme.title: Rendel: Dark Vengeance

programme.title: Red Riding: 1974
programme.desc: When a young girl goes missing, Yorkshire Post crime reporter Eddie Dunford (Andrew Garfield) becomes intrigued by a series of mysterious child murders that date back several years and mirror to the current case. He faces stiff opposition from the local police and his editor, Bill (John Henshaw). Eddie's troubles escalate when he becomes involved with a moody widow (Rebecca Hall) who has a mysterious connection to wealthy developer John Dawson (Sean Bean).

programme.title: Hopscotch
programme.desc: When CIA operative Miles Kendig (Walter Matthau) deliberately lets KGB agent Yaskov (Herbert Lom) get away, his boss (Ned Beatty) threatens to retire him. Kendig beats him to it, however, destroying his own records and traveling to Austria where he begins work on a memoir that will expose all his former agency's covert practices. The CIA catches wind of the book and sends other agents after him, initiating a frenetic game of cat and mouse that spans the globe.

programme.title: Sliding Doors
programme.desc: When Helen, a London ad executive, is fired from her job and rushes out to catch a train, two scenarios take place. In one, she gets on the train and comes home to find her boyfriend, Gerry, in bed with another woman. In the second, she misses the train and arrives after the woman has left. Following the first scenario, Helen dumps Gerry, finds a new man and gradually improves her life. Under the second scenario, she becomes suspicious of Gerry's fidelity and grows miserable.

programme.title: Chef
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Squadron 303: The Battle of Britain
programme.desc: Polish fighter pilots defend the United Kingdom during the Battle of Britain.

programme.title: The Gambler

programme.title: Jane Got a Gun
programme.desc: Panic strikes Jane Hammond (Natalie Portman) when her outlaw husband John returns to their farm with bullet wounds. Expecting the worst, she brings her young daughter to safety and travels to the home of Dan Frost (Joel Edgerton), a boozing ex-lover who may be her only hope. With Dan now on her side, Jane prepares for a showdown with the vengeful John Bishop and his gang of thugs. Looking to settle an old score, Bishop must now contend with the gun-toting Jane and her new partner.

programme.title: City on Fire
programme.desc: An undercover cop (Chow Yun-Fat) infiltrates a gang of jewel thieves, but things go terribly wrong during a heist.

programme.title: The Stepfather
programme.desc: Jerry Blake (Terry O'Quinn) is a family man, but he happens to have a series of families, with each one on the receiving end of his murderous ways. When Jerry sets his sights on a lovely widow named Susan (Shelley Hack) and her headstrong daughter, Stephanie (Jill Schoelen), it appears that his brutal pattern of killings will continue. However, Stephanie begins to suspect that there's something wrong with the seemingly well-adjusted Jerry, and a violent confrontation is inevitable.

programme.title: Silent Night, Deadly Night Part 2

programme.title: The Heart of Me

programme.title: The Decline of Western Civilization Part II: The Metal Years
programme.desc: In this follow-up to the 1981 punk rock documentary "The Decline of Western Civilization," filmmaker Penelope Spheeris dissects the world of heavy metal. Through live performance footage and interviews that feature popular hard rock musicians, Spheeris examines the metal genre and the opulent Los Angeles music scene of the late 1980s; highlights include Ozzy Osbourne discussing the tedium of sobriety over breakfast and Aerosmith's Steven Tyler claiming to have spent a small fortune on drugs.

programme.title: Giant's Migration
programme.desc: On the coast of south Africa, a group of mammoth mammals is arriving from the deep ocean. Every year humpback and southern right whales make incredible migrations from the Antarctic seas to mate and give birth along southern Africa's rich protected coast. Just arriving in time won't be enough to guarantee a mate. Humpbacks conduct awe-inspiring aerial displays and chaotic competitions for attention before showing off their grace in underwater ballets.

programme.title: Magical Fjords
programme.desc: Fjords are one of the most dramatic landscapes on Earth, but their majesty is just the tip of the iceberg. Fjords stand witness to some of the greatest wonders of the animal kingdom. Fjords are found in a frozen land where only the toughest survive. Whether just below the surface, at the murky depths of the sea floor or on dry land, the fjords offer an incredible bounty to wildlife.

programme.title: On a wildlife mission
programme.desc: As soon as she arrives, conservationist Hannah Emde immerses herself in Namibia's wildlife. The first destination of her trip is the world-famous Naankuse Foundation near Windhoek. In addition to a veterinary clinic, the sanctuary includes 85,000 hectares of wilderness, where endangered and rescued animals live.

programme.title: Fighting for a Mate
programme.desc: Animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. Every battle is a trade-off between the risk to health and the prizes awarded to the victors. Each animal fights with a unique set of tools, from display structures and elaborate body language to claws, jaws and antlers. And few fights are as fuelled as those during breeding season; the ultimate trophy for the brave fighter is, of course, a chance to pass on the fighting genes to the next generation.

programme.title: Brown Bears and Salmon
programme.desc: When Spring comes one animal arrives in its thousands. It's the salmon. Travelling an incredible 3500 miles through rivers and streams they are Alaska's hardiest resident. Using their muscular bodies they can swim up stream jumping over any obstacle that comes in their way. But there is one grizzly hazard they face right at the end of their journey. It's the brown bears. These expert fishermen use skill and accuracy to grab onto the salmon with their powerful teeth.

programme.title: Deserts
programme.desc: All habitats present difficulties, but the challenges of the desert are more obvious than most - scorching heat and a lack food and water make them one of the most hostile environments on the planet. But with great challenges come incredible solutions. Despite the deadly conditions, a hardy band of unique animal and plant species have adapted to meet the inhospitable desert conditions head on.

programme.title: The last rhinos
programme.desc: The poaching of rhinos for their horn has brought these animals to the brink of extinction. Namibia's black rhinos are hard to find. The Save The Rhino Trust has been fighting for the protection of the pachyderms every day for 30 years under the most adverse conditions. Hannah Emde accompanies the anti-poaching unit through the semi-desert for a day. She learns how difficult it is to track the animals and can hardly believe her luck when she finds a mother with her calf.

programme.title: January
programme.desc: In Europe in January, we sit around in the dark, missing the bright lights and festivities of Christmas, perhaps it would cheer us up to imagine January around the world. To the north, polar bear cubs are born and nestle against their hibernating mothers, but on the other side of the planet, kangaroos are experiencing the highest temperatures and having to trek in search of water, while in East Africa, wildebeest arrive on their breeding grounds and enjoy a baby-boom on a giant scale.

programme.title: Zanzibar: Land of Giants
programme.desc: Lying 40km off the east coast of Tanzania in Africa, the Zanzibar Archipelago has been labelled the most exotic island chain in the world. Pristine sands and azure blue sea make it a much loved holiday destination, but bizarre creatures, many of enormous size, also roam the islands. The world's largest crab scales trees in search of coconuts, and clouds of giant bats fill the skies at dusk.

programme.title: Meet the Mustelids
programme.desc: To many ears the name mustelid might sound mysterious and confusing. They may sound strange, but this family of hunters are probably much more familiar than you think. They're tiny terrors; ankle-height tigers of the undergrowth. From the icy northern climbs where the bold wolverine quietly rules the forests, scattering wolves with a fearsome glance, to the sun-drenched wetlands of the Amazon where man-sized giant otters work together to protect their families and defend their homes.

programme.title: Fight for Life
programme.desc: Nature is red in tooth and claw - animals face daily battles to protect themselves and secure the resources they need to survive. Every battle is a trade-off between energy spent, the risk to health and the prizes awarded to the victors. Each fighter has a unique set of tools and techniques available to dispatch their opponents. For predators to find food, lower links in the food chain have a fight on their hands escaping the jaws of death. Their only options are to die, run or turn and fight.

programme.title: Creepy Crawlies - Breeding
programme.desc: Birds do it, bees do it, and so of course do the smallest members of the animal kingdom. Finding a mate is not merely a human pursuit, and few creatures put more vigour, variety and unexpected twists into their love-lives than creepy crawlies! They fill the air with their gentle music and they write their love in the sky. Some battle it out while others just embrace in tender caress. Stand by as they prove that sexual prowess has nothing to do with size - as the creepy crawlies start breeding.

programme.title: The Dry Forest
programme.desc: The dry forest, which once covered the entire Pacific coast of Central America, now exists only as isolated "vestiges". In Costa Rica, however, it has been revived and even expanded thanks to the efforts of biologists and the local population. Here, the population of jaguars, a top predator, is increasing. This unique forest - dense, abundant and colorful during the rainy season, camouflaged and asleep during the dry season - is home to a splendid diversity of plants, trees and wildlife.

programme.title: Death
programme.desc: Salmon, Bears, Beluga Whales, Naked Mole Rat, Bacteria, Aspen Trees In this episode, we explore how different animal species react to impending death. We explore the factors that lead animals to their final resting places: disease, injury, predation, drought, famine. Some species, such as the naked mole rat, while not immortal, seem to be able to effectively protect themselves from certain diseases such as cancer.

programme.title: Kipling's Paradise
programme.desc: The Western Ghats are amongst some of the most biodiverse regions in the world, and these mountains are the ancestral birthplace for many of India's endemic species. This episode delves into India's jungle heart, and the mysterious forests nestled in the shadow of the Western Ghats' great peaks. Amongst these trees lies the fabled world from the pages of history, and the character counterparts to the West's most cherished tales of India - Rudyard Kipling's 'The Jungle Book'.

programme.title: Place of Hope
programme.desc: Five critically endangered African species find protection in one modest haven - De Hoop Nature reserve is not only a World heritage Site its's also incredibly important for the survival of these iconic animal. 36,000 hectares are home to the rare and plucky Cape Mountain Zebra; the beautiful Bontebok; one of the last remaining breeding colonies of Cape Vultures; the African Black Oystercatcher and the mighty Southern Right Whale.

programme.title: Europe's Green Heart
programme.desc: Europe was once covered by forest, from the Arctic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea. Wiped out in a mini ice age around 15000 years ago, they, and the wildlife that inhabit them are making a spectacular recovery. Today, Europe's forests cover around 1 000 million hectares (about 30 times the size of Poland).

programme.title: Water Kingdoms
programme.desc: Argentina's northern territory contains one of the largest reserves in the country. Iberá is a vast expanse of swamps, marshes and lagoons, with a biodiversity count to rival the Pantanal. These lands are bursting with life, home to over 4000 animal and plant species. The rainy season in Iberá finds the wetlands in bloom... but unseen perils lurk beneath the surface, and even here, life can be a struggle for survival.

programme.title: Hidden Russia
programme.desc: There's no doubt Russia has it all: from the subtropics to the arctic and the Atlantic to the Pacific; giant lakes, active volcanoes and endless forests.

programme.title: February
programme.desc: In the northern hemisphere February is one of the toughest months of the year, the seemingly unending cold and scarce food of winter. Some animals fail, but their bodies become a bounty that will see carnivores and scavengers through. In parts of Africa animals face the opposite problem, high temperatures and overdue rains and must trek to find food and water. While the Amazon has the opposite problem, too much water, with the rainforest wildlife having to adapt to a submerged forest.

programme.title: Manawatāwhi/ Three Kings islands
programme.desc: Where the South Pacific Ocean meets the Tasman Sea, thirteen islands stretch across the blue desert as if a giant has tossed rocks from the sky above, Manawatāwhi/ The Three Kings Islands. Ancient, wild, and remote, this ocean junction bewitches many who visit. Upwellings of cold nutrient rich water support a spectacle of marine life, while a small pod of Bottlenose Dolphins has given up their nomadic ways to make this place their home.

programme.title: Meet the Pigs
programme.desc: What first comes to mind when you think of pigs? Mud wallows and pink, curly tails? Perhaps lucky symbols and money banks, or maybe just bacon sandwiches? Whatever it is, you're probably underestimating the world's amazing collection of pigs. Today they might be one of our favourite farm animals, but if we visit their cousins in the wild we start to reveal the unique and wonderful world of the pig.

programme.title: African Savannah
programme.desc: Grasslands cover nearly fifty percent of the African continent. African grasslands support vast and diverse wildlife. Due to the open and uncovered nature of grassland, predators are much easier to spot, giving smaller animals a chance to run away, hide and survive. Thanks to the lack of hiding places for predators, the African savannah regions support a much greater diversity of wildlife than temperate grasslands.

programme.title: The Great Barrier Reef
programme.desc: One of Australia's most remarkable natural gifts. The Great Barrier Reef in all it's breath-taking beauty. It is the world's largest coral reef, acknowledged as one of the seven wonders of the natural world, and viewed from a greater distance it's easy to understand why. It is larger than the Great Wall of China and the only living thing on earth visible from space. The Great Barrier Reef supports a vast array of life forms.

programme.title: Arctic
programme.desc: The Arctic is alive with a fascinating assortment of wildlife and species that are unique to this Polar environment. Most of are rarely or never seen outside the Arctic Circle. They live and thrive in a hostile environment of ice, polar desert, wind-swept open tundra, ancient glacial formations, sub zero sea temperatures and an incredible variety of geographical topo-graphy from open plain and valleys to mountainous peaks and deep water fiords.

programme.title: American Praire
programme.desc: Prairies are a temperate grassland. Vast great plains, extremely hot in summer and cold in winter. Moderate rainfall, and a composition of grasses, herbs and shrubs, rather than trees characterise these plains. Most of North America was a vast prairie before European settlement and agriculture radically altered the environment.

programme.title: The Killer Coast
programme.desc: Stretching almost 1000 miles, from the jungles of Brazil to the southernmost point of South America, Patagonia's coast is home to some of the natural world's most spectacular animals. Here, a parched desert collides with a powerful ocean, but right along this extreme and hostile coastline, animals battle the elements and each other, in a fight for survival.

programme.title: Mountains of Extreme
programme.desc: This episode follows the animals of Argentina, living life at the mercy of the Andean mountains. These peaks dictate a hard existence for every living creature from their summits to the very edge of the Patagonian steppe, forcing even the cutest resident to turn carnivore... Predators stalk the foothills and creepy crawlies lie low in the sandy steppe. Every animal here has a bloodthirsty drive to survive.

programme.title: Return to the Wild
programme.desc: The two oldest rhinos are set to be released back into the wild. Three rhinos cause a stir as they go missing, while the younger rhinos make steady progress toward health and happiness. A new volunteer arrives in time to see the release, but will it end in disaster?

programme.title: Wolves - Power of the Pack
programme.desc: From arctic tundra to the great planes, the kingdom of the wolf extends across the entire northern hemisphere. They are icons of the wilderness, spectacular creatures that live and die by the sword. Though magnificent predators on their own, the feature that perhaps makes wolves so iconic is the pack. The close bonds, complex communication and sheer muscle of a team of wolves is almost unstoppable. And the pack's not just the day job, it's the cornerstone of family life for a wolf.

programme.title: Weird and Wonderful
programme.desc: This episode will introduce you to some of the Aquariums most weird and wonderful inhabitants. From upside-down Jellyfish to male Seahorses giving birth, these wacky residents make up the enchanting world that keeps guests coming to through the Aquarium doors! But other pressing issues keep the staff busy, from keeping the peace between man and seal, to preparing a new gigantic predator tank, there's not a minute to rest in the life of an Aquarist!

programme.title: Chiribiquete
programme.desc: Chiribiquete is an unknown world, hidden deep within Colombia's Amazon. Pre-historic towers, waterfalls and deep canyons lie surrounded by rivers, lakes and rainforests bursting with life. Scientists have only guessed at what else lies beneath this impenetrable pristine jungle - until now. Biologist Blanca Huertas from England's Natural History Museum, and Colombian-born nature photographer Francisco Forero, head deep into the heart of nowhere.

programme.title: Nature's Most Dangerous
programme.desc: Few things make us shiver like the thought of falling prey to one of the world's great predators. With teeth, claws, stings and venom, they inflict death on their prey, and instil fear in us. But who's not a thrill seeker among us? We humans love to put ourselves at risk and lap up the thrill of living dan-gerously. And to fuel our fetish for fear, we turn to the animal kingdom, imagining close shaves with all the planet's most dangerous creatures.

programme.title: The Caribbean: The Wild Side of Paradise
programme.desc: Between the continents of North and South America is a tropical paradise: the Caribbean. This archipelago of over 7,000 islands and reefs lies within the crystal clear waters of the Caribbean Sea. From just a few metres wide, to hundreds of kilometres across, every island is different, and each has its own unique wildlife.

programme.title: British Garden: Life And Death On Your Lawn
programme.desc: The British back garden is a familiar setting, but underneath the peonies and petunias is a much wilder hidden world, a miniature Serengeti, with beauty and brutality in equal measure. In this 90-minute documentary Chris Packham and a team of wildlife experts spend an entire year exploring every inch of a series of interlinked back gardens in Welwyn Garden City. They want to answer a fundamental question: how much wildlife lives beyond our back doors?

programme.title: Trophy hunting - just killing or conservation?
programme.desc: Hannah Emde tries to illuminate the subject of trophy hunting from all sides. She talks to the Khwe chief, villagers and game guards in the Zambezi region. She meets a trophy hunter and follows the topic back to Germany, where she exchanges ideas with Izak Smit, the Chairperson of Desert Lions Human Relations Aid, Delhra in short.

programme.title: Galapagos: Darwin's Eden
programme.desc: Situated 1,000km west of Ecuador in South America, the Galapagos archipelago contains 13 main islands and a hundred or so smaller rocks and reefs. The region's wilderness is so pristine and rich in life it altered our entire view of the natural world. It was the Galapagos islands' finches and mockingbirds that proved key to Darwin's theory of evolution.

programme.title: The Fragile Islands/Andaman
programme.desc: What seems calm and tranquil may not necessarily be so. Under the tranquility there maybe a vibrant dynamic world and above water there maybe dangers which are lurking at very corner. Mahatma Gandhi Marine National Park is one such. In the Andaman Islands a group of 15 islands make up this fragile eco system. Coral, is one of the most productive and endangered wild fauna in the shallow coastal waters.

programme.title: Rhino Rescue Cote d'Ivoire
programme.desc: In the heart of the Ivory Coast a small rural village has a very special resident. The last white rhino in the country sleeps on the village outskirts and feeds on the villagers' crops. He's survived a gunshot to the shoulder and a decade of civil war, and he's something of a celebrity here. But all is not well. The rhino has killed the chief of the village, and it's time for him to go.

programme.title: The Marine Ecosystem
programme.desc: Costa Rica is home to some of the richest marine ecosystems in the world; biologists and conservationists have undertaken a race against time to better understand and protect marine ecosystems.

programme.title: Return of the Shan/Hemis
programme.desc: Snow Leopard is the one of the most elusive big cats in the world. This episode details how the wildlife guards and the wildlife department has set up conservation and scientific plans to protect and indeed to enumerate and increase it's population. For the first time we see the radio collaring operations of the big cats and also the very rare Lynx. The episode also shows how the guards live and work in these tough terrains sometimes even by putting their lives in danger.

programme.title: Wild Wolverine
programme.desc: To many the wolverine is the stuff of movie superheroes. To others they are a creature of myth and legend. They look like a weird hybrid between wolf, bear and skunk and are some of the toughest, strongest and most aggressive animals around. In the sub-arctic forests of Siberia survival is an expert skill. The creatures of the far north strike a delicate balance and must show ingenuity and cunning if they are to survive.

programme.title: Fight for Territory
programme.desc: Biological instinct is driven by three things: the desire to stay alive, to find food and to breed. But to do all these things, animals first need a home. Out in the wilderness a safe place to call home can be the difference between life and death. A place to secure meals, raise their families and hide from danger. Ideal spots are in short supply and well worth fighting for!

programme.title: July
programme.desc: As schools break up for summer and kids can play in meadows amid poppies and singing sky larks, wildlife around the world has very different stories to tell. Lemmings are going crazy. On the Arctic tundra, the ground's frozen for most of the year, now they need to make the most of the time of plenty. But the giving summer heat is too much in southern Spain, where pools are drying out leaving fish high and dry, a feast for herons.

programme.title: Icy Coast
programme.desc: Cold coasts create challenging landscapes for all wildlife. It's hard to believe that these freezing oceans can be bringers of life. In fact, cold water holds onto oxygen much better than warm, encouraging aquatic activity. Great eagles hunt abundant marine life in the bleak northern hemisphere whilst cold water corals thrive off the nutrient rich currents passing through their reefs, and massive elephant seals fight for territory off the coast of Australia.

programme.title: Beaver Lumberjacks
programme.desc: Anchorage has a rather unique resident who is renowned as nature's lumberjack and North Americas largest rodent, the beaver. With their powerful teeth the trees they fell can be huge and their dams can be so enormous they can be seen from space. But since humans arrived here, many beavers have been forced to live in an urban jungle! And as the Wild City of Anchorage expands, that means more people, more cars, and the biggest risk to the beavers, dogs!

programme.title: Artic Refuge
programme.desc: Alaska one of the last true wildernesses on earth. With 600 square miles of pristine habitat this state is home to an abundance of wildlife. Herds of caribou roam the plains, wolves stalk in the forest and the brown bears are the kings of the rivers. But you don't always have to head to the wild to come face to face with an animal. In the city of Anchorage the wildlife is a lot closer than you think, because a city with so much green space means everywhere is fair game for its wild neighbours.

programme.title: Naledi: A Baby Elephant's Tale
programme.desc: Under a blanket of stars on an African night, in the serene grasslands of Botswana's Okavango Delta, something rarely witnessed by humankind is about to happen: the much-anticipated birth of a baby elephant. An emotional life-or-death drama that champions the struggle of Africa's native elephant population, Naledi: A Baby Elephant's Tale tells the urgent story of an international crisis.

programme.title: Coasts - Life's a Beach
programme.desc: To us the beach is one giant playground, but for wildlife it's a place to live, to find food and to raise their young. Amongst the fish and chips, sandcastles and donkey rides it's easy to forget that beaches are vital habitats, home to a myriad of animals. Whether grey seals are duelling for a mate and raising their young, or black bears and tigers are scouring the coastline for a tasty snack, animals have been using the beach for millennia.

programme.title: Jungle of Asia
programme.desc: Some of the most beautiful rainforest, jungle landscape and wildlife are in Asia. The rainforests of Asia stretch from India and Burma in the west to Malaysia and the islands of Java and Borneo in the east. The Great teak forests and Jungles in Asia have long been under threat from intensive logging and industrial farming of cash crops. Slash and burn agriculture has also taken a heavy toll on the eco-structure and environment. Bangladesh has the largest mangrove forests in the world.

programme.title: Open Ocean
programme.desc: It might look uniform from the air, as we fly over it, but the oceans are deep and varied. The underwater landscape is made up of continental shelves, volcanoes, mountains, valleys, trenches and large, flat plains similar to the landscape on land only on a much larger scale. Ocean habitats come in all forms. Under water creatures make homes wherever survival is assured.

programme.title: Westlands
programme.desc: Large areas of water, broken up by small islands. Massive vegetation. Swamps, wetlands, marshes, bogs and fens are found all over the world, generally in more temperate regions where there is fast vegetation growth. Many of the larger animals that inhabit swamps and wetlands have a fish-based diet. LARGE CRABS dwell in the salt-water swamps, along with SNAPPING TURTLES and even CROCODILES AND ALLIGATORS. LIZARDS AND AMPHIBIANS live in and around the water's edge.

programme.title: Desert
programme.desc: Deserts - dry, arid landscapes, environments of intense sun, heat and very little rain. The desert is extreme. An extre-me climate and an extreme environment where wild life has had to adapt to survive. Many of the animals that live in deserts have adopted a nocturnal lifestyle, surfacing only at night when it is cooler.

programme.title: Mammal Takeover
programme.desc: With the dinosaurs' passing, a land of opportunity was laid bare for the little mammals that had scampered about their feet.

programme.title: Mountains - Gateways to Heaven
programme.desc: Mountains define our most spectacular landscapes. As they climb the changing altitude results in a mosaic of dramatic habitats, teaming with incredible wildlife. programme.desc: As Hot Wheels Monster Trucks Live rolls into Edinburgh, TX, grab a behind the scenes look and meet the legendary monster trucks, including Bone Shaker and Tiger Shark. Get a sneak peek of our superstar freestyle motocross riders and the car-eating, fire-breathing robot, Megasaurus.

programme.title: Ford vs Chevy: Small Displacement Showdown
programme.desc: The TIMELESS Debate is on. Ford vs. Chevy. We start with a stock 305 Chevy and a 302 Ford. After an initial baseline, we see how they stack up against each other with the same mild upgrades. We find out, dollar for horsepower, who comes out on top.

programme.title: Launching a 680HP Big Block Chevy Jet Boat
programme.desc: It's revelry and rooster tails for our guys on the lake! The 680-hp jet boat gets turned loose on the water for high-speed fun. But, where are the brakes?

programme.title: Drifting Trailblazer SS Gets a New Carbon Fiber Hood
programme.desc: From Stock, to powerful... Our Trailblazer SS gets a refresh in the power department, and some style points with a carbon Fiber Hood.

programme.title: Drifting Trailblazer SS Is Ready for the Track After Suspension Upgrades
programme.desc: The Trailblazer SS goes from super sport to drifting sport...suspension upgrades and a power adder cap off the project sending it to the track!

programme.title: Dirt Oval Destroyer
programme.desc: The UNOH motor sports team pays a visit to Engine Power to build a race-ready small block to meet the new class rules at their local dirt track. The students help us put together a 434ci small block with 23 degree heads for the competitive stock car class. Once it's completed, we prove it's race-ready on the Dyno and look for big gains over their previous powerplants.

programme.title: Small Block Showdown Round 4
programme.desc: Our 305 Small Block Chevy and 302 Small Block Ford return for another round of the brand loyalty war. In this matchup, both engines get aftermarket higher flowing induction and solid roller valvetrain to increase their RPM range and power. We'll find out if the stalemate ends and if the Blue Oval or the Bowtie comes out on top.

programme.title: Ford F-250 Project Part 1: Heavy Hauling
programme.desc: The MCT guys bring in the F-250 shop truck for some upgrades to help with hauling our fleet of trailers. They install a gooseneck receiver hitch and air lift suspension. Plus they'll upgrade the braking capabilities to help slow down those heavy haulers.

programme.title: Project Fat Stack - Part 12
programme.desc: Interior Decorated - Tommy and Joel cut a rug and freshen up the rest of Fat Stack's interior to match the flashy exterior of their 1971 Chevy Caprice.

programme.title: Jeep JK Part 2: Trail Accessories
programme.desc: The guys put the final touches on the Jeep JK, adding a new bumper and winch. Plus, we'll show you a few techniques on how to fix poorly installed nutserts.

programme.title: Improve Horsepower and Torque: High-Performance Tips For LS Engines
programme.desc: Go from the boneyard to making big power! Mike and Pat have the high-performance tips and techniques to help you get the most horsepower and torque with some savings to boot!

programme.title: Super Street 427ci SBC Part 2
programme.desc: We continue with our aftermarket pump gas 427ci Small Block Chevy engine, with plans on getting it into the Dyno Cell. It's getting finished off with a high flowing, off the shelf induction and rock solid valvetrain before we run some 93-octane fuel thru it and see what it puts out on the Dyno.

programme.title: Pre-Runner Ranger Part 2
programme.desc: We're getting our Coyote engine and transmission installed in our 2002 Ford Ranger!

programme.title: Crime Busting Cruiser Crown Vic At The Track
programme.desc: We finish work on our Ford Crown Vic Police Cruiser Spec Panther race car by adding a racing-look paint scheme and new wheels and tires. Then we hit the track to see how well it performs!

programme.title: Ram Diesel Turbo Swap & Exhaust
programme.desc: The Ram 1 ton dually gets a bigger badder turbo setup with more airflow for more horsepower. Plus, Advanced Plating in Nashville shows us how to powder coat suspension parts.

programme.title: This Horse Has Horsepower
programme.desc: It's time to triple the horsepower in our 1990 Mustang! Project Fast Lane Fox Body is getting a new heart, as Tommy and Peyton make final adjustments to their pony car's new Windsor motor. Plus we'll show you how to install a new fuel injector pump with a pro from Edelbrock.

programme.title: Building the Next Stage of Test Sled
programme.desc: Mike and Pat move to the next stages of the Test Sled build including top end performance goodies, racing seats, an accessory drive, and custom tail lights.

programme.title: From a Flat-Head to a Chrysler Slant-Six, to a Ford FE to a boosted Chevy Straight-Six
programme.desc: From a Flat-Head to a Chrysler Slant-Six, from a Ford FE to a boosted Chevy Straight-Six, Mike and Pat celebrate their vintage builds and how they turned retro into big modern muscle.

programme.title: Supercharged '89 K5 Square Body Searches For a Mud Hole
programme.desc: The supercharged big block Blazer hits the trails in search of a big mud hole.

programme.title: Chevy C-10 - Part 6: Bed Redefined
programme.desc: Work continues on our '72 Chevy C-10 Project Cream Puff as the Music City Trucks crew relocates the hood hinges for a cleaner, more functional front end. Then, it's all about strength and style as they fabricate a custom bed frame to support our short-bed conversion. Plus, we'll hit the road to visit a top-tier custom interior shop that is specializing in the DIY guy.

programme.title: Chevy K1500 5.3 LS Swap
programme.desc: LT hoists the tired 350 from the engine compartment for a budget conscious 5.3L LS.

programme.title: Restoring a Scuffed Up Windshield - Road Runner Part 6
programme.desc: We get into some arts and crafts to create a one-of-a-kind emblem that redefines ransom wear and we'll use some wool to clear up Road Burner's eyes. When it's all said and done, the guys will be literally exhausted.

programme.title: Hard Charger Power Plant Reveal
programme.desc: It's time to reveal the engine that's going to power the 1969 Charger project, and a viewer's Chevelle gets a helping hand with a Driveway Rescue.

programme.title: Dodge Challenger Tears It Up At NCM Motorsports Park
programme.desc: The Challenger tears it up at NCM Motorsports Park! Plus we'll help a viewer perk up her pickup in this week's Driveway Rescue.

programme.title: Tearing Down a Duramax to Prep for 1000 HP
programme.desc: We take apart our 6.6L Duramax from our '11 Denali HD for an upgrade to 1000HP. Plus, we meet a diesel junkie who built a Cummins powered Ford Ranger pocket rocket for the dragstrip.

programme.title: Driveway Rescue: Z71
programme.desc: We help one of our viewers take care of some essential safety items on her '99 Chevy Z71.

programme.title: Building An Exhaust To Fit The Abandoned Chevy Silverado's 5.3L LS - Part 3
programme.desc: We continue to work on our abandoned '96 Chevy Silverado truck, buttoning up underneath the hood with cooling and power steering installations. Plus we build a custom exhaust for our freshened up 5.3 liter engine.

programme.title: Tackling The Worn Out Road Runner Interior - Part 4
programme.desc: Tommy and Joel give the '69 Road Runner's interior a much-needed makeover. We'll restore the dash and give the seats and headliner some much needed attention.

programme.title: Faux Guy Square Body Screams '80s With Chrome Wagon Wheels
programme.desc: The frame work for our 1985 Chevy K-10 is being blasted and painted. We add a new fuel system and assemble it all back together. We get this K-10 chassis on a new set of wheels and tires and add our freshly painted cab.

programme.title: Cooling Down & Increasing Power On The '71 Chevy Caprice
programme.desc: Cool Running - We install the cooling system on our '71 Caprice and then put the pedal to the metal to give you the lowdown on electronic throttle vs mechanical.

programme.title: Dropping the Hammer On The Retro Rocket Hurst Olds - Part 5
programme.desc: Tommy and Joel visit a museum in a Lane of its own to see some one-of-a-kind vehicles. Then, they head over to the track to put the pedal to the metal on their '83 Hurst Olds retro rocket!

programme.title: The '91 Suburban Gets A Triple Stick Shifter
programme.desc: Our Unbreakable Chevy Suburban makes its final preparations for payoff with completion of the engine bay, drivetrain, exhaust, and interior.

programme.title: 600+ Horsepower 2nd Gen Camaro Shakedown
programme.desc: With over 600 horses the Gen II is ready to pound the pavement! From the street, to the track, to the strip, this split bumper is a beast. We also take you inside the PRI Show to checkout the latest in race engine technology.

programme.title: Pit Pass at a NHRA Race Weekend
programme.desc: Meet the graduates of SAMTech who have found a home in NHRA racing.

programme.title: Low-Fi S-10: This Project is Coming Together
programme.desc: We are on the home stretch of our '95 Chevy S-10 Mini Slam Project. We begin to button things up, including the driveshaft, exhaust, shocks and more. The end is in sight as we get closer to laying frame.

programme.title: Axles, Tires and Turbo, Oh My!
programme.desc: It's time to get our shop projects back on track. Chris and Eric tackle axles for Project Spartan, their '69 M715 Jeep Kaiser build, and they'll turbocharge the shop's Polaris UTV for future off-road adventures.

programme.title: Ford F-250 Project Part 2: Functionality Features
programme.desc: The MCT Ford F-250 gets a few more features added to help performance and function while hauling. We improve throttle response, plus help our visibility with new work lights.

programme.title: How to Build a 1000HP Diesel Beast
programme.desc: Modifying a Duramax to make 1000 Horsepower starts with a teardown and some machining before the new performance parts are added. Plus Austin mods up the body for a cool clean look.

programme.title: Project Bullseye - Match Game
programme.desc: Paint by numbers - Painting a '69 Dodge Dart? We'll show you how to get perfect factory-match paint! Our 1969 Dodge Dart, Project Bullseye, is a bare shell providing the perfect blank canvas. Brian will show you some easy DIY color mixing methods for perfect pigment matching paint to get your project back to factory spec.

programme.title: Project Creep it Real Part 3
programme.desc: The team is adding a transfer case, hydraulic steering and getting the JK riding on 40s!

programme.title: 427 cubic inches of Naturally Aspirated HP for Javelin Trans Am Tribute Build

programme.title: Keeping it F-100

programme.title: '69 Charger Front End Assembly

programme.title: Low-Fi S-10: New Audio System & Interior

programme.title: Easy Upgrades for a Stock Big Block Chevy

programme.title: Stage 2 Ram Wrap-Up

programme.title: Project Shell Shock - Brakes, Wiring & More!

We're also adding power windows for a little extra comfort, and giving our interior trim panels a quick facelift with some fresh paint. It's all about knocking out the details that make this classic that much better.

programme.title: 69 GTO Part 8 - Power Moves

programme.desc: Marcia siente que Fernando pone muchos pretextos para no ir con ella y le pide a Alicia que lo siga; Lety les dice a las del cuartel que saldrá a festejar con Tomás y le confiesa a Eduardo que está enamorada de Tomás.

programme.desc: Alicia le dice a Marcia que sospecha que Fernando fue a una casa de citas; Julieta y Don Erasmo le presumen a Fernando todos los logros académicos de Lety.

programme.desc: Román y un joven se suben al automóvil de Marcia y Alicia y reciben una rociada de gas pimienta; se arma un escándalo y todos son llevados a la delegación para aclarar la situación.

programme.desc: Alicia le aconseja a Marcia ir tras Patricia Manterola; Omar le dice a Fernando que Lety salió destrozada de la oficina. Fernando acepta que Luigi trabaje para Patricia Manterola. Marcia, Omar y Fernando viajan a Alemania.

programme.title: The Black Rainbow
programme.desc: In a mind bending finale, the secret of Warren's dream is unlocked when they reach their final destination, the "Black Rainbow" drone launch facility.

programme.title: The Haunting Of Whaley House

programme.title: Ape vs. Mecha Ape

programme.title: Corporate Retreat
programme.desc: Our Heroes find themselves with a group of white-collar survivors and someone tries to kill Murphy. Suddenly faced with a possible killer in their midst, our Heroes play a dangerous game of "Clue"-with zombies!

programme.title: Alien Origin
programme.desc: Recently discovered footage from a lost military expedition exposes the horrifying truth about the genesis of life on earth.

programme.title: Frenemies
programme.desc: Doc and Our Heroes are reunited with Sketchy and Skeezy when they take refuge in a working Barber Shop full of mysterious, and murderous, characters

programme.title: The Anacondas
programme.desc: Explorers in Mexico uncover the ruins of an ancient snake-worshiping civilization. Celebration turns to horror when they awaken an ever-growing anaconda, starved of human sacrifices for centuries. Now, the team must band together to survive.

programme.title: Evil Nanny
programme.desc: A couple hires a live-in nanny, who soon starts showing her neglectfulness. However, the nanny established legal residency in the home, embarking the couple on a legal battle to reclaim their home.

programme.title: Exorcism The Possession Of Gail Bowers
programme.desc: Based on one of the true incidents that inspired THE EXORCIST, a psychiatrist suggests that the parents perform an actual Catholic exorcism on their daughter, who actually believes she is possessed.

programme.title: Alien Siege
programme.desc: After an alien space craft appears above Washington, D.C., a disparate band of residents in a small Connecticut town must fight off a unit of alien soldiers on the hunt for the President of the United States after his escape chopper crash lands nearby.

programme.title: 5-Headed Shark Attack
programme.desc: A beautiful island's aquatic life faces a new terror: the 5-Headed Shark, a demented starfish-shaped monster threatening Puerto Rico's beaches

programme.title: Dracula: The Original Living Vampire
programme.desc: Det. Amelia Van Helsing hunts a killer of young women. All evidence leads to the untouchable Count Dracula.

programme.title: AE Apocalypse Earth
programme.desc: A group of refugees from Earth land on an exotic planet, where they must fight ruthless aliens to survive.

programme.title: King Arthur and the Knights of the Round Table
programme.desc: In this modern retelling of the classic tale, facing certain defeat, Merlin banishes the evil enchantress Morgana and her son Mordred to the ends of universe. Vowing revenge, Morgana and her son return to Earth, hell-bent on destroying every last descendant of King Arthur and his Knights.

programme.title: Battle For Pandora
programme.desc: After a help signal from a research vessel makes it back to Earth, the Space Force sends a rescue ship to Pandora. They discover Pandora is already inhabited by a highly evolved species that won't give up their Earthling prisoners without a fight.

programme.title: All Good Things Must Come to an End
programme.desc: Our Heroes drive through Los Angeles on their way to the mobile CDC lab. They discover the CDC lab isn't just a lab...it's a submarine! Dr. Merch welcomes our Heroes aboard and not a moment too soon as the Zeros show up hot on their heels.

programme.title: Fracking Zombies
programme.desc: In need of gas, the team follows a suspicious stranger to a damaged oil refinery deep inside a New Jersey no-go zone packed with zombies.

programme.title: Ape X Mecha Ape: New World Order
programme.desc: After an attempt on Abraham the giant ape's life, a journalist uncovers a global plot to awaken an ancient creature. Humanity's last hope is an uneasy alliance between Abraham and Mecha Ape MkII to stop the threat and save the Earth.

programme.title: Zunami
programme.desc: When the last surviving cosmonaut crashes to earth, Citizen Z gets a real live buddy, but it quickly becomes clear that his new friend has a secret agenda. Meanwhile, a massive zombie herd forces the team to take refuge in a morgue.

programme.title: Crisis of Faith
programme.desc: Warren's inability to stop the mayhem causes a crisis of faith in the whole group. Surrounded by Zombies in an abandoned church, their faith is restored after encountering a mysterious stranger who turns out to be something much more.

programme.title: Airline Disaster
programme.desc: Domestic terrorists skyjack the world's largest passenger plane on its maiden voyage. When the President is notified that her brother is on board, she must choose between family and the safety of the people in the cities below.

programme.title: Mt. Weather
programme.desc: Warren and Our Heroes must stop Zona from launching operation "Black Rainbow" which will release a flesh eating bacteria to "cleanse" the landscape of zombies -- and humans -- so Zona can repopulate the mainland with their offspring.

programme.title: We Interrupt This Program
programme.desc: Searching for a transmitter to contact Kaya at Northern Lights, Our Heroes discover an abandoned TV NEWS STATION.

programme.title: Ape vs. Mecha Ape
programme.desc: Recognizing the power of its captive giant Ape, the military makes its own battle-ready, Mecha Ape. But its first practical test goes horribly wrong, leaving the military no choice but to release the giant Ape to stop the robot.
Jack and Melissa are frightened by their son's bizarre and violent behavior; they soon learn that he is the gateway to the Apocalypse, and it will happen on his birthday, 11-11-11.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Ten years after the events of the first film, Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are settled in 1935 London, where they are raising their son. When a chain of events finds the corpse of Imhotep resurrected, the O'Connells go on a desperate race to save the world from unspeakable evil and to rescue their son before it is too late.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Cursed by a devious sorceress, China's ruthless Dragon Emperor (Jet Li) and his vast army lie buried in clay for millennia. When young archaeologist Alex O'Connell is tricked into reviving the emperor, he and his famous parents (Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello) must find a way to send the ghoul back to the grave before he can awaken his vast army and take over the world.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
programme.desc: Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: After Norwegian researchers discover an alien ship buried in the ice, paleontologist Kate Lloyd (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) joins the team at the isolated Arctic outpost to investigate. She finds an organism that appears to have perished in the crash eons ago but, in fact, is about to awake. Freed from its icy prison, the insidious life-form goes on the attack. Paranoia spreads like wildfire among the crew as they fight to survive against a creature that assumes the shapes of its victims.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: The Purge
programme.desc: In an America ravaged by crime and overcrowded prisons, the government sanctions an annual 12-hour period during which all criminal activity -- including murder -- is legal. James Sandin and his family face the ultimate test when an intruder drags the vicious outside world into their home. James, Mary and their two children struggle to survive the night while trying not to turn into monsters like the ones they are striving to avoid.

programme.title: The Purge: Election Year
programme.desc: As a young woman, Sen. Charlie Roan survived the annual night of lawlessness that took the lives of her family members. As a presidential candidate, Roan is determined to end the yearly tradition of bloodlust once and for all. When her opponents hatch a deadly scheme, the senator finds herself trapped on the streets of Washington, D.C., just as the latest Purge gets underway. Now, it's up to Leo Barnes, her head of security, to keep her alive during the next 12 hours of mayhem.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
programme.desc: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Housesitter
programme.desc: Architect Newton Davis (Steve Martin) is distraught when his girlfriend, Becky (Dana Delany), spurns his proposal and refuses to move into the lavish house he designed for her. Davis, who cannot imagine himself living alone in the house, shares his tale of woe with Gwen (Goldie Hawn), a dishonest waitress he thinks doesn't speak English. Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: Air
programme.desc: A miraculous mantle envelops the entire planet - a thin skin of gasses called 'air'. Without it, there would be no life or weather, no habitable conditions, or protection from lethal ultraviolet radiation or meteorites from outer space.

programme.title: Land
programme.desc: It's the solid crust of our planet, the perfect element in which to record the stories of deep time and of lifetimes. Change and progression is the way of earth. Air and water turn solid rock into soil.

programme.title: Water
programme.desc: How the flow of water has the power to shape all inhabitants on Earth, produces climate-changing weather and supporting species, from the largest whales to microscopic plankton.

programme.title: Desert Survivors
programme.desc: Arid and unforgiving, deserts push their inhabitants to the extreme; from the desert elephant to the shovel-snouted lizard, see how they survive.

programme.title: Lords of the River
programme.desc: Rivers are the life veins of this planet, offering all those that depend on them respite from both heat and thirst; a look into how for the life they give, they also take away.

programme.title: Impenetrable Forests
programme.desc: Africa's rainforests are second only to the Amazon in size; see these tangled worlds, that are home to chimpanzees, gorillas and forest elephants, one of the last remaining strongholds for the planet's wild creatures.

programme.title: Mars: Earth That Never Was
programme.desc: Scientists study the history of Mars and explore the possibility that it once contained life.

programme.title: How Large Is the Universe
programme.desc: Scientists look out deep into space hoping to measure the size of the universe based on the relatively miniscule portion of space observable from Earth.

programme.title: Crashing Into the Moon
programme.desc: Several countries plan to send spacecraft to the moon, potentially leading to a permanent human presence in space.

programme.title: Birth of the Moon
programme.desc: Scientists map the surface of the moon and piece together its history to determine how it formed and learn more about Earth's origins in the process.

programme.title: Attack of the Sun
programme.desc: Scientists probe the sun to learn more about coronal mass ejections, violent periodic outbursts that disrupt Earth's electrical systems.

programme.title: Supermassive Black Hole in the Milky Way Galaxy
programme.desc: Astronomers study stars and ultra-dense objects near the center of the Milky Way Galaxy to learn more about the black hole at its heart.

programme.title: Volcano Eruption
programme.desc: A deadly volcano eruption causes catastrophic destruction, and a tornado flips cars on a highway.

programme.title: Maryland Flashfloods
programme.desc: Flash floods tear through Maryland in the US, a couple get stranded in a Himalayan blizzard, and a boat race is besieged by a rare weather phenomenon.

programme.title: Superstorm Sandy
programme.desc: Hurricane Sandy whips up wild waves in the Atlantic, prompting a rescue mission by the U.S. Coast Guard; cavers in California get caught out by flash floods; wild winds cause a crash for hot air balloonists; residents narrowly escape a landslide.

programme.title: Tornado Terror
programme.desc: A twister outbreak in Texas leaves a storm chaser trapped; in Florida, dangerous riptides drag swimmers out to sea; a sudden storm hits a holiday resort in Greece; a giant wave crashes through a restaurant in Italy.

programme.desc: The LA Fire Department battle to rescue residents trapped by the flames in California; the biggest twister to hit the US for 60 years rips apart Joplin, Missouri; in Antarctica, a husband and wife brave extreme elements to set a new record.

programme.title: Fearsome Flooding
programme.desc: Queensland, Australia is shaken by the most devastating flood in its history; in Kansas, two storm chasers track a terrifying twister; a base jumper gets stranded in freezing temperatures in Iceland; a destructive hail storm pummels Texas.

programme.title: Lords of Gravity: Outer Limits

programme.title: The Milky Way

programme.title: The Big Bang

programme.title: Cosmic Rays
