programme.title: Landsat
programme.desc: Examining Landsat 8, the advanced planetary explorer with a 900 million dollar price tag, which is designed to reveal complex and ever-changing details undetectable by the human eye.

programme.title: The Curiosity of Mars
programme.desc: A vehicle spent a year on Mars.

programme.title: The Age of Hubble
programme.desc: An army of high-tech telescopes, led by Hubble in space, has delivered an unprecedented chain of discoveries about how galaxies took shape, how stars live and die, and how life arose.

programme.title: Asteroid Mining: The New El Dorado
programme.desc: States and corporations around the world are now investing in the field of asteroid mining activity.

programme.title: Mile Wide Tornado
programme.desc: A tornado tears a mile-wide path through the American town of Moore, Okla., destroying two schools while the pupils are inside.

programme.title: Cruise Ship Disaster
programme.desc: A holiday cruise ship sails into a hurricane, terrifying 4,000 passengers as their cabins are plunged underwater.

programme.title: Snowpocalypse
programme.desc: Hurricane Patricia rips apart a Mexican holiday resort sending tourists fleeing for their lives.

programme.title: Earthquakes and Avalanches
programme.desc: In 2015, a massive earthquake in Nepal triggers a deadly avalanche on Mount Everest and mudslides that bury whole villages.

programme.title: Australia Inferno
programme.desc: Firefighters run out of water as an inferno rages through South Australia killing 70,000 livestock and chasing tourists at 30 miles per hour.

programme.title: Giant Sinkhole
programme.desc: A man films as a deadly tornado flattens his home and destroys every single house in a small town in Illinois.

programme.title: Return to Disaster
programme.desc: Second Return to Flight test flight.

programme.title: Mars or Bust
programme.desc: As the clock ticks toward the critical Mars launch window, NASA scrambles to fix a space mistake.

programme.title: Space Shuttle Shuffle
programme.desc: Despite multiple pressures, a shocking discovery causes NASA to cancel a historic launch.

programme.title: Cloud Cities of Venus
programme.desc: 50 km above its desolate surface, the cool cloud tops of Venus offer a potential refuge for life.

programme.title: Venus: Doing Science In Hell
programme.desc: Venus' surface is twice the temperature of a pizza oven; yet engineers push the boundaries of science to build probes that can deliver data from the depths of this crushing inferno; experts describe their battle strategies and technologies.

programme.title: Planet Hunters
programme.desc: Astrophysicists at the forefront of the search consider the possibility of finding a planet like Earth among any of the bodies discovered by a new space-based telescope.

programme.title: Eye of Ida
programme.desc: Witnessing Hurricane Ida's devastation as it reduces Louisiana to rubble; following a man running for his life from California wildfires; facing a deadly sea swirl with a Norwegian ship crew; looking for a snow kiter engulfed by an avalanche.

programme.title: Turkey Tsunami
programme.desc: Rescuers aid a young girl trapped under rubble after a Turkish earthquake, all while a tsunami threatens to add to the turmoil; a father and daughter escape Oregon wildfires; a flash flood upstages an outdoor wedding.

programme.title: La Palma Volcano
programme.desc: Molten lava devours homes and lives when a volcano erupts on La Palma; an entire U.S. town submerged by endless downpours; colossal ice boulders in Italy.

programme.title: Tornado Terror
programme.desc: An Ontario man flings into a tornado; a helicopter and jet ski rescue team go into an intense flood; an avalanche crashes a party; an adventurer survives being trapped upside down in a raging river in Papua New Guinea.

programme.title: SuperTornado: Anatomy of a Megadisaster
programme.desc: The 2011 Super Tornado carved a mile wide path of destruction through Joplin, Missouri.

programme.title: Lake Geneva: The Giant Tsunami
programme.desc: In 563 AD, Geneva was destroyed by a tsunami, and it could happen again.

programme.title: Tsunami: Facing the Global Threat
programme.desc: Tsunamis are so sudden and powerful that in a matter of minutes, they can wipe out a coastline.

programme.title: Why Our Forests Are Burning Up
programme.desc: A group of experts studying the range and impact of megafires examine why these blazes are beyond control, what makes them insatiable and what is causing the crisis.

programme.title: How to Survive on a Burning Planet
programme.desc: A team of experts introduces both ancient and newly discovered fire prevention techniques that can help confront the era of megafires to protect homes and families.

programme.title: Part 1
programme.desc: Floods are a growing threat to our planet, posing engineering and technological challenges.

programme.title: Urban Resilience
programme.desc: This episode focuses on the notion of urban resilience, visiting trailblazer cities around the world.

programme.title: Category 5 Fury
programme.desc: The Bahamas get pounded by 200mph winds during category five Hurricane Dorian - the most intense cyclone the country has ever seen; in Arizona, flash flooding sweeps a couple away resulting in a heart-stopping rescue.

programme.title: Wall of Flames
programme.desc: Wildfires rip through Victoria, Australia. In Texas, a skydiving training session ends in disaster when there's a major midair collision at 30,000 feet.

programme.title: Tornado Warning
programme.desc: In Arkansas, two storm chasers help warn people that a tornado is barrelling towards them, wreaking havoc on downtown Jonesboro and leaving a trail of destruction. In Idaho, a daredevil adventurer decides to swim beneath a frozen lake.

programme.title: Trapped by Fire and Water
programme.desc: In Australia, the worst bushfires in recent history attack multiple towns - overwhelming firefighters and trapping tourists; The Philippines is usually resilient to natural disasters, but a 6.4 magnitude earthquake catches everyone off-guard.

programme.title: Eye of Ida
programme.desc: Witnessing Hurricane Ida's devastation as it reduces Louisiana to rubble; following a man running for his life from California wildfires; facing a deadly sea swirl with a Norwegian ship crew; looking for a snow kiter engulfed by an avalanche.

programme.title: Turkey Tsunami
programme.desc: Rescuers aid a young girl trapped under rubble after a Turkish earthquake, all while a tsunami threatens to add to the turmoil; a father and daughter escape Oregon wildfires; a flash flood upstages an outdoor wedding.

programme.title: La Palma Volcano
programme.desc: Molten lava devours homes and lives when a volcano erupts on La Palma; an entire U.S. town submerged by endless downpours; colossal ice boulders in Italy.

programme.title: Tornado Terror
programme.desc: An Ontario man flings into a tornado; a helicopter and jet ski rescue team go into an intense flood; an avalanche crashes a party; an adventurer survives being trapped upside down in a raging river in Papua New Guinea.

programme.title: Factory Five Build School
programme.desc: Willie B goes on location to experience a two day build school for a Factory Five Roadster.

programme.title: Exhausting Technology
programme.desc: Kevin and Willie swap out performance headers on a Z51 Corvette, showing how not all headers are alike.

programme.title: Clean to Custom
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno completely overhaul the interior of a C20. Changing out the seats, dash accessories and door panels. We're going from Clean to Custom on Truck U.

programme.title: Color Match
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno show you how to personalize your Jeep with some paint and fabrication.

programme.title: Fishing Trucks
programme.desc: It's a fishing day on Truck U. Matt and Bruno take two trucks and get them ready to tow with a turbo rebuild and some towing accessories.

programme.title: Back to stock
programme.desc: To sell this Longbed C-10, Matt and Bruno need to get it back to stock. They transform the interior back to a factory style bench seat. The exhaust also gets a factory style upgrade.

programme.title: Patina Shortbed
programme.desc: Patina C-10 trucks are all the rage. Matt and Bruno leave the paint alone on a 69' C10 project and give it the fine details it needs to look like a finished look.

programme.title: Revived Raptor
programme.desc: It's back, the new Ford Raptor is here and Matt and Bruno can already make it faster and sound better with aftermarket parts.

programme.title: Day in the Dirt
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno find a lowrider truck that has some handling problems. So they fabrication some suspension components and do some interior work.

programme.title: Chevy Day
programme.desc: Line 'em up. It's a Chevy day on Truck U as Bruno and Matt look at a couple of bowtie trucks in the shop. They do everything from styling upgrades to common problem fixes, and as always, they give you some life lessons along the way.

programme.title: You Like My Cuda?
programme.desc: Willie shows off the new engine in his '67 Barracuda and gets Kevin to help upgrade his wiring and brakes.

programme.title: Then and Now
programme.desc: When a 1949 Chevy pick-up shows up at the shop, Kevin and Willie take a look at how far technology has come.

programme.title: Rotor Runout
programme.desc: The guys tackle an issue with runout on a good set of rotors with the use of an on-car lathe.

programme.title: Diesel Engine Tech
programme.desc: The guys do a complete deconstruction of the new Scorpion diesel engine, showing how the new technology and block design completely revolutionized the 6.7L engine.

programme.title: Project C5: Part 1
programme.desc: Kevin and Willie take the engine out of a C5 Corvette, tear it down, and get it ready for a performance rebuild.

programme.title: Mustang Clutch
programme.desc: The guys swap out a damaged clutch on a 2012 Mustang and go for performance with a lightweight twin plate clutch.

programme.title: LS1 Engine Build
programme.desc: Our C5 project continues with a build up of the lower end of the LS1 engine.

programme.title: Project C5: Part 3
programme.desc: The suspension gets completely reworked on the C5 Corvette. Then the guys finish up the engine, getting it ready for re-install.

programme.title: Beat the Drum
programme.desc: It's time to beat the drums off a 1965 F100. Matt and Bruno do a full disc brake conversation and upgrade the master cylinder and booster.

programme.title: Outdoors Jeep
programme.desc: Today on Truck U, we blend Matt's love for the outdoors with Bruno's love for performance and styling on a Jeep JK.

programme.title: We don't void warranties
programme.desc: Bruno and Matt try to find a way to void the factory warranty on a long haul Tundra.

programme.title: Camping in Comfort
programme.desc: Matt helps a buddy get his Ram 2500 Longhorn ready for it's next camping and hunting trip. As a trade out he gets a little party time in the trailer.

programme.title: Truck U Checklist
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno have a large Truck U checklist. They have to get a Bronco Project running again. Bruno has a racer friend stopping by who needs a hand and Matt shows us the new shop purchase.

programme.title: K5 Blazer
programme.desc: Time to get low with a K5 Blazer. Matt and Bruno are going to C-notch the frame and and this 73' blazer while still using the factory wheels and tires.

programme.title: Operation Comfort
programme.desc: Bruno takes a trip to San Antonio, Texas to meet the soldiers of Operation Comfort and see what makes their Bronco Weapons Carrier so special

programme.title: Monster in a Box
programme.desc: Bruno and Matt put together a Monster transmission from scratch and start building the tube chassis for the Rock Racer

programme.title: Supercharged Jeep
programme.desc: Jeeps are notoriously underpowered, but it's nothing a supercharger can't fix.

programme.title: Body Panel Replacement
programme.desc: The guys do their best to help a friend out with some body damage on a 1950 5-window pickup truck. Will it become too much to handle?

programme.title: Cooling Maintenance
programme.desc: A 2000 Silverado comes into the shop with a recurring cooling problem. The guys put their detective hats on and find the root of the problem.

programme.title: Let's Roll
programme.desc: The guys learn what it takes to finish King of the Hammers with the ESAB sponsored Ultra Four race truck in the shop.

programme.title: Ford EcoBoost
programme.desc: Kevin and Willie B. highlight the inner workings of the EcoBoost engine and show how it's changing the game on the racetrack. Plus, Kevin gets a rare look behind the doors of Ford Racing's dyno facility.

programme.title: How to Buy a Classic Car
programme.desc: Willie B. and Kevin do some detective work on a '55 Nomad that may be the next addition to Willie's collection. Meanwhile, a Jeep Wrangler is in the shop for an illuminating upgrade.

programme.title: Pratt & Miller
programme.desc: Kevin heads to the world-renowned Pratt & Miller Engineering Headquarters for a closer look at the company's upcoming projects and legendary past.

programme.title: EcoBoost Unleashed
programme.desc: Kevin and Willie B. tap into the pent-up power of a Ford F-150 EcoBoost by adding a new water-methanol injection system, intake, and exhaust before strapping it to the dyno.

programme.title: Ford Common Problems
programme.desc: Not all trucks are perfect. Matt and Bruno dissect some common Ford problems in the engine and suspension.

programme.title: Air Bag It Part 1
programme.desc: Bruno and Matt improve the ride quality and tow capacity on our Ford Super Duty tow project by installing an adjustable airbag system.

programme.title: Air Bag It Part 2
programme.desc: We finish the Air Bag kit on our Super Duty tow project and put it to the test on the road.

programme.title: Street Truck
programme.desc: Bruno and Matt install some upgrades on a 2010 Ford F 150 to make it more roadworthy

programme.title: King of the Hammers
programme.desc: Matt heads out west to find out what makes the King of the Hammers one of the fastest growing races in the world.

programme.title: See It Made-Surf City Garage
programme.desc: Bruno Massel takes a trip to Huntington Beach, California to see a garage of Dream Cars that inspired a company.

programme.title: Rock Racer
programme.desc: The Chassis for the Rock Racer is almost done, so Matt and Bruno add a Speedwire System and install the torque converter.

programme.title: Small Engine
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno replace a small engine on a go kart and get some help from some kids on a special project.

programme.title: 120,000 Mile Maintenance
programme.desc: Willie B. and Kevin bring in a high-mileage truck for a routine check-up and walk us through some repairs every car owner should know.

programme.title: Moab Jeep
programme.desc: Kevin and Willie B. take on the challenge of outfitting a Jeep for a rental company whose customer base isn't known for driving cautiously.

programme.title: Mustang Power
programme.desc: Kevin and Willie take a factory-supercharged Ford Mustang Shelby GT500 to the dyno and put its full horsepower potential to the test by adding a water-methanol injection system.

programme.title: G-Body Engine Swap
programme.desc: Willie B. and Kevin bring an old 442 into the shop in hopes of bringing it back to life, starting with a new engine and transmission.

programme.title: Adventure Mobile
programme.desc: The team at TheBlock.com asks for help from Kevin and Willie B. to outfit the ultimate road trip truck and raise awareness for a worthy cause.

programme.title: Upgrading a Classic
programme.desc: Kevin and Willie give a classic C-10 pickup a few improvements. Meanwhile, work continues on an ongoing 2015 truck project.

programme.title: Wrap This Up
programme.desc: Kevin and Willie are on a mission to finally finish two ongoing projects that have been taking up space in the garage.

programme.title: Duramax Diesel
programme.desc: Willie B. and Kevin bring in a big truck with a big number on the odometer, in hopes they can keep it running for many more miles.

programme.title: Work and Play #1
programme.desc: Bruno and Matt need to create an ultimate truck for work and play. They get a visit from Clint at ATS Diesel and find out what's available in the aftermarket for performance.

programme.title: Work and Play#2
programme.desc: Work continues on the Dodge Work and Play Project Truck. Today, we help the ride with a wireless air bag system and add some much needed storage capability.

programme.title: Steering Geometry
programme.desc: Learn why a truck's steering geometry is such an important issue to address after installing a lift kit on your truck.

programme.title: Fouled up Ford
programme.desc: What causes a misfire in your engine? Follow Bruno and Matt as they travel through a diagnostic journey to find an answer to the problem.

programme.title: Toy Hauler Build-Up
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno take an enclosed car trailer and turn it into a toy hauler with all the amenities of home.

programme.title: Get It Started
programme.desc: Matt and Bruno diagnose a "no-start problem" on an '05 Chevy Silverado and get some help with the repair from NASCAR Crew Chief Alan Gustafson.

programme.title: Ask the Hosts
programme.desc: Whether they are on the road, or in the garage, Bruno and Matt find answers to technical questions everyday. Today, they will answer some of your viewer questions while working on a new truck.

programme.title: Cummins Diesel-Built to Last
programme.desc: One million miles may sound like a lot - but NOT for a Cummins Diesel engine. Today, we'll find out what makes these incredible engines built to last.

programme.title: Flippin' the Bird
programme.desc: The ghouls detail and assemble the suspension of the '70 AAR Cuda 340 Six Barrel car. The owners of the '70 Plymouth Superbird, in the queue for resurrection, visit the shop and Daren convinces the crew to throw a birthday party for Mark.

programme.title: Fish n' Chips
programme.desc: Mark takes some time for himself and leaves Daren in charge of the shop. The crew gets the newly painted panels installed on the '70 Cuda 383 Automatic FE5 Rallye Red Car. And Mark discovers a chip on the '71 'Phantasm' Tribute car and no one will own up to it.

programme.title: Game Day
programme.desc: The fuel and brake lines are installed in the '71 'Phantasm' Tribute car. Daren quits and won't return until Mark begins the restoration of his '70 Plum Crazy Challenger. A phone-call from the Phantasm car owner forces Mark to make a promise he might not be able to keep.

programme.title: Phantasm 'Cuda
programme.desc: The GYC crew is under the gun to get the '71 Cuda 340 Triple Black 'Phantasm' Tribute car finished by the end of the week. With the exhaust, ornamation, and the engine start still ahead of them, will they be able to finish the car before the director of the 'Phantasm' movie franchise arrives?

programme.title: Back in Triple Black
programme.desc: Mark and the team rush to complete the triple-black, '71 Cuda, Phantasm homage car. The director and star of Phantasm, Don Coscarelli and A. Michael Baldwin, visit Graveyard Carz to check out the homage car and hopefully, drive it around town.

programme.title: AAR You Ready for This?
programme.desc: The team tears down Mike Hill's '70 Superbird and finishes up final touches on Chris Driscoll's '70 AAR Cuda. Daren confronts Mark about stealing parts from his car and Mark gets a rematch on Chris Driscoll's race track.

programme.title: Go for It!
programme.desc: Holly asks Mark if she can work on cars. Mark Cain from Bad Boy Blasters brings the crew a huge gift. The '70 Barracuda Convertible is torn down and sent to the dipper, progress is made on the '70 Sunroof Challenger and Mark gets a surprise from one of his favorite actors.

programme.title: Get Your Hands Dirty
programme.desc: Mark installs the hood decal on the '70 Sunroof Challenger, Holly helps Josh disassemble the Barracuda suspension, Mark and Daren work on the 440 engine for the Challenger, and the team assembles one of the rarest Mopar options, the sunroof for the '70 Challenger.

programme.title: W-O-M-A-N, Mark Woman
programme.desc: The team rushes to ready the '69 Dodge Daytona for Tom Partridge and his family's visit. The guys settle a leadership dispute the old fashioned way, the Graveyard Carz van gets a face lift, and Daren retaliates when Mark won't let him sign for deliveries.

programme.title: Pop Secrets
programme.desc: Holly helps Mark on the '70 Challenger, Daren annoys everyone with his popcorn and causes Mark to damage a very rare car. Tony D'Agostino, from Tony's Mopar Parts, visits and lends a hand on the '70 sunroof Challenger. Mark let's Holly in on the big secret and Daren reveals a secret of his own.

programme.title: Let the Sunshine In
programme.desc: Mark gets a portable showroom, the '70 Hemi Charger is dissembled and the team finishes the 1970 Sunroof Challenger. Mark finally reveals his big secret project to the Graveyard Carz team and Royal makes a video tribute to the Sunroof Challenger.

programme.title: The Royal Treatment
programme.desc: Mark and the ghouls build out the 440 Super Commando engine for their '70 Plymouth Superbird and install the suspension for the '69 Daytona Charger. Daren finally has enough of Marks foolishness.

programme.title: The Grand Torino
programme.desc: Body man Derrick becomes an official Graveyard Carz crew member and assists in the disassembly of the rare '67 Plymouth Hemi GTX Convertible. Josh and Daren play "the game" with Mark.

programme.title: The Waltons
programme.desc: Mark and the Ghouls get a massive sheet-metal order from AMD for their '70 Plymouth Superbird. Meanwhile, the owners of the '72 Charger visit and talk about what made their car so special. Daren gets the offer of a lifetime on his '70 Challenger R/T.

programme.title: It's the Great Pumpkin, Goldberg!
programme.desc: It's a Moparween at Graveyard Carz! Just when things couldn't get crazier, Bill Goldberg shows up to go over his '68 GTX Convertible and knock some sense into the guys. He can handle the NFL and the WCW, but can he hold his own at GYC?

programme.title: Daytona Reborn Pt. 1
programme.desc: Mark is behind on his promise to get Tom Partidge's '69 Daytona Charger finished by the end of the month. The crew kicks into high gear to get Tom's Daytona looking great and out the door.

programme.title: Daytona Reborn Pt. 2
programme.desc: Mark is behind on his promise to get Tom Partridge's '69 Daytona Charger finished by the end of the month. The crew bands together to do whatever is necessary to fulfill Mark's promise to the owner and bring it back to life.

programme.title: Top 10 Mopar Muscle Moments
programme.desc: The Ghoulz pay tribute to their favorite moments over the previous seasons. This special episode looks back over seasons 1-3 of Graveyard Carz, but includes all new interviews to highlight some previously unrevealed details.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Peter's under extra pressure when he heads out to see Charlie the horse - he belongs to his niece Jess. She's always loved horses and rides them competitively, so Charlie needs his wolf teeth removing so they don't interfere with the bit.

programme.title: Farm Babies
programme.desc: We are visiting the farm to meet up with the baby animals, piglets, chicks, lambs and calves keep us entertained.

programme.title: More Spring Babies
programme.desc: Coyote pups enjoy a romp, baby fox cubs spend time attacking mum's tail, and beavers have fun in the water.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Peter heads to a local farm where Bernie the boar is strangely off his food. Peter's worried that the problem could be serious, but examining a big boar who's not feeling well isn't easy.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Peter's called out to a cow with stomach problems, he calls in reinforcements from his new Grace Lane Practice. Julian has a surprise examining a pregnant dog. A frisky Shetland Pony and a lizard with a dead tail end are also treated.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Are happy new couple Tim and Fiona the right fit for the 'cloud on legs' Frosty? She's a plucky Pomeranian but, at 11, isn't getting any younger. And will kelpie Schnitzel find love this time around?

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Julian dashes to an emergency - Vet Matt needs an experienced pair of hands. A young heifer, Bonnie, is struggling to give birth naturally. Peter sees old pal Benji the bouncy border terrier who has been vomiting and is in grave danger.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: In this episode, Peter is mystified by the contents of Khufu the cat's stomach after his owner is concerned that he has totally lost his appetite. Peter performs surgery on the cat but when he opens its stomach, he gets the shock of his life!

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: A mum-to-be is struggling to give birth to her very large calf. Julian needs to perform an emergency c-section, but issues arise so Julian drafts in help from another vet, Candela. Only their vast experience and quick thinking can save them.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: The Trainee RSPCA Inspectors have reached the halfway point in their extraordinary year of teaching, testing and on-the-job assessment. If they make it to the end, the students will become fully-fledge Inspectors, but should they fail at any point, they'll be off the course. The group face their toughest challenge of their year so far.

programme.title: Snow Babies
programme.desc: This day takes place in some of the coldest regions on the planet. Polar bear cubs, penguin chicks, fox kits, and elk calves are among the many animals featured.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: The second of this 2 part special follows Inspector Lyndsey Taylor who last episode rescued four dogs from squalid conditions.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: A newborn lamb is brought to the hospital after being found abandoned by the roadside. The lamb arrived in a bag for life, but Matt and David have their work cut out to save his life.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: In this episode, farmer Richard Todd brings one of his much-loved semi-feral moggies into the practice. But 'Pretty Tom' isn't living up to his name. Peter believes the lump on Tom's face could be a life threatening tumour. To be safe, the mass must be removed urgently but Peter knows it will be extremely difficult surgery. Against all odds can Peter, with the help of Vet Helen, save Pretty Tom?

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: In the first of this 2 part special, Inspector Lyndsey Taylor gets down and dirty as she rescues 4 dogs from a squalid house. Three of the poor dogs are shut into separate rooms and living in their own waste. One is so traumatized that it has a seizure.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Peter heads to a local farm to try and save a sheep and her unborn lambs. A little pug has a broken leg and Julian meets Lucy the overweight llama.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Julian Norton has problems with a highland cow called Hilda and Peter Wright performs life-changing surgery on a panting pug named Bramble. The vets also treat a donkey and a swan whose love lives are causing concern.

programme.title: Episode 9

programme.desc: Following an accident between a woman's car and a 15-year-old boy at an intersection, the driver sues for damages caused to her vehicle and for emotional distress; Dashcam footage shows the teenager's alleged involvement in a game of chicken.

programme.title: Assault, Infidelity, and Nigerian Matrimony
programme.desc: Unwed parents sue each other for the court max of $10000 amid claims of assault, vandalism and infidelity; with a second baby on the way, an alleged marriage-for-citizenship involving a Nigerian family member comes into play.

programme.title: Corgi Custody
programme.desc: A man says his ex-girlfriend stole their corgi and broke their lease; the woman claims she had to leave because of his abuse and insists the dog belongs to her.

programme.title: Family Road Rage Drama
programme.desc: A blended family sues their landlords after their lease is terminated, triggering a legal dispute involving claims of harassment, false restraining orders, and property damage; a road rage incident follows.

programme.title: Teen Victim's Strategic Surveillance
programme.desc: Two mothers sue each other for damages following a fight between their daughters; the victim, fearing for her safety, aims to capture evidence and ensure her mother's protection.

programme.title: Rims, Barter and Betrayal
programme.desc: Car enthusiasts argue over an unpaid debt for prized car rims, a failed barter deal and accusations of aggravated harassment.

programme.title: Love, Loans, and Laid to Rest and Baby Shower
programme.desc: After a quick relationship, a single mother sues her ex for $5K used on a loan, he insists they weren't exclusive and that she knew he spent the money on his mother's funeral; a woman claims the father of her children was violent at her baby shower.

programme.title: Friendship Turned Live-Streaming Fisticuffs
programme.desc: A woman sues a former friend, claiming that she only had $100 left to pay off on a car before it was repossessed; countersuing for an assault, her ex-friend submits proof of a mutually-violent altercation captured in a live-streaming video.

programme.title: Shirt Storm
programme.desc: Two ambitious entrepreneurs from California accuse a man of failing to fulfill their order for custom t-shirts after full payment; the manufacturer claims mislabeled and allegedly unsellable shirt issues are fixable.

programme.title: Toddler, Tax and Truck Trouble
programme.desc: Unwed parents battle over the right to claim their child as a tax deduction and contest ownership of shared property; child protective services intervene to ensure that the toddler's best interests are protected.

programme.title: Van Heist Justice
programme.desc: A driver carrying the weight of parking tickets transfers ownership of his van to an unsuspecting friend to avoid paying fines; when he amasses more ticket violations, she repossesses the vehicle only to have it stolen; he sues for its return.

programme.title: Labradoodle Litigation
programme.desc: A man refuses to pay the adoption fee for a sick Labradoodle puppy; he claims that vet bills far outweigh the animal's value; he admits to giving the pup away when the seller did not retrieve it; he already has 22 other dogs.

programme.title: Defamation, Drugs and Betrayal (Part 1)
programme.desc: A woman loses her job after being accused of drugging and assaulting her coworker during an overnight business trip.

programme.title: Defamation, Drugs, and Betrayal (Part 2)
programme.desc: After claims of gross misconduct on a business trip, co-workers fight for the court's maximum amount; their dueling defamation charges hinge on conflicting recollections of that night.

programme.title: Weed, Wheels, and Wisecracks
programme.desc: A 25-year-old is being sued by his father for the court maximum of $10K as reimbursement for bail and legal expenses following the son's arrest on Super Bowl Sunday for driving under the influence and carrying concealed weapons.

programme.title: A Father's Fight for Justice (Part 1)
programme.desc: A young father sues his ex-fiancée for the $10,000 court maximum, claiming false assault charges led to a sweeping restraining order preventing him from seeing their children for two years.

programme.title: A Father's Fight for Justice (Part 2)
programme.desc: A former couple tells conflicting stories of violence, highlighting a chaotic Valentine's Day dispute that ends with a hospital visit and competing police reports.

programme.title: Gun Brandishing Brother
programme.desc: A gun-wielding brother faces charges of domestic violence and assault after an altercation at his grandfather's house.

programme.title: Barbershop Battle and Dental Adventure in Colombia
programme.desc: A barbershop owner accuses her former employee of breaching a non-compete agreement by opening a nearby shop; a couple breaks up and proceed to fight over who should pay for dental work.

programme.title: Tire-Slashing Nuptials
programme.desc: Tensions escalate as a woman accuses her future stepdaughter of tire slashing and social media slander; the stepdaughter counters with claims of an eviction, illegal lockout and theft of her property.

programme.title: Feuding Neighbors Caught on Tape (Part 1)
programme.desc: A pharmacist takes legal action against his neighbor, alleging an uncompromising campaign of harassment including police reports triggered by accusations of illegal drug use, drug dealing and violent domestic disputes.

programme.title: Feuding Neighbors Caught on Tape (Part 2)
programme.desc: A longstanding neighbors' fight reaches new heights, leading to court appearances, protective orders and a mass of vulgar conduct captured on camera.

programme.title: Sentimental Silicon Bust and Sancho Showdown
programme.desc: A woman sues her former friend for $3,500, claiming the friend's unattended 5-year-old son ruined her decade-old breast implants, stored in a sealed bag in her bedroom.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Competing lawsuits blow up between a tenant and her landlord, powered by the loss of subsidized housing, drug accusations and an eviction; claims of property damage and accusations of running a puppy farm come into play.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: The $10,000 court maximum is at risk as an elderly landlord faces a terrifying arrest due to false allegations of gun possession; his tenants deny claiming that he aimed an AR-15 at them, while the landlord insists it was retaliation.

programme.title: Standoff After Bar Stabbing
programme.desc: Former friends sue each other for 10,000 dollars after an altercation at a bar where one woman stabbed the other two; claims of self-defense and counter-claims of harassment become further complicated.

programme.title: Runaway Groom
programme.desc: A mother seeks payback for wedding expenses from her daughter's ex-fiancé after he ended the engagement; he attributes the failed nuptials to the mother's interference and a contentious prenuptial agreement.

programme.title: Assault, Corgis, and Emotional Support Fraud
programme.desc: Former partners battle over competing assault allegations and the custody of their two beloved corgis, one of whom makes an appearance and charms the entire courtroom.

programme.title: Family Legacy at Stake and Rental DUI Delinquency
programme.desc: A woman sues her ex-partner of 25 years after enduring a forced eviction and alleged abuse in their shared home; a yoga instructor returns from abroad to discover that the woman who rented her car for three years had a DUI.

programme.title: Joy Ride Blow-Up
programme.desc: Teenagers fight over an unauthorized three-minute joyride that results in a blown engine and sizable repair bill; blame shifts to the sports car owner when video evidence of a high-speed freeway ride is introduced.

programme.title: Dog Breeder's Fight for Frenchie
programme.desc: In a canine custody battle, a man brings his dog breeder friend to court over Gizmo, a French bulldog; the dispute uncovers ethical concerns about animal welfare in the breeding industry.

programme.title: Road Rage Knife Fight (Part 1)
programme.desc: A woman sues for damages to her car after a heated altercation between her grandson and the defendant; tensions erupted when the grandson flipped off the defendant for honking at him for walking too slowly across the street.

programme.title: Road Rage Knife Fight (Part 2)
programme.desc: The conflict reignites the next day when a knife is allegedly brandished, triggering a frantic struggle; in the chaos, the car sustains damage when the two parties engage in mutual combat ending in the arrest of both young men.

programme.title: Birthday Bash Turns Brutal
programme.desc: A 31st birthday getaway to Tillamook, Oregon, takes a dark turn when a woman sues former friends for an alleged assault during a drunken argument.

programme.title: Pomsky's Day in Court
programme.desc: A woman sues her ex-boyfriend for custody of their rescue dog, Luka, who makes an appearance in court; the man alleges mistreatment of the pomsky by her teen grandson, citing incidents of physical discipline.

programme.title: Car Crush
programme.desc: A single mom from Vegas squares off against her dad's neighbor from Arizona over a disputed car deal.

programme.title: Breaking and Not Entering
programme.desc: A man sues a former friend for thousands in property damage after his window is shattered during a late-night confrontation involving an intoxicated girlfriend and a botched apology.

programme.title: Dangerous Passenger; Where Is Disney World?
programme.desc: A 40-year-old man sues his 23-year-old half-brother over injuries sustained in a violent altercation; a woman sues her niece for a Disney trip that fell apart after they mistakenly booked airline tickets to the wrong city in Florida.

programme.title: Buyer Seller Showdown
programme.desc: A woman sues a former acquaintance for selling her a faulty 20-year-old BMW, which broke down days after purchase; In retaliation, the man vandalizes the car, claiming she still owes money.

programme.title: Missing Cat Revenge and Sisterhood of Traveling Drama
programme.desc: A man sues his ex-friend for negligence after two cats entrusted to his care go missing; Friends sue their traveling companion, claiming she abandoned their planned trip to Brazil.

programme.title: Renter's Stabbing Standoff
programme.desc: A man accuses his former landlord of assault; he claims that she attempted to stab him with a broken mirror during a heated altercation; the man allegedly refused to vacate the premises amidst a rent dispute.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Diplomatic Immunity
programme.desc: Bobby rescues a woman from a vicious attack but his noble action threatens to end his career. Buffeted by lies and facing the stonewall of "diplomatic immunity."

programme.title: The Mentor
programme.desc: Sue meets Jack and Bobby's FBI Mentor when he brings the team in on a case to sting a North Korean terror group. Lucy reconnects with her old high school love.

programme.title: Troy Story
programme.desc: Sue is shocked to discover her friend Troy has been arrested for armed robbery. Bobby learns his girlfriend has received a job offer that means relocating to Los Angeles.

programme.title: Spy Games
programme.desc: Sue becomes the only link between the FBI team and a rogue British agent with amnesia. Jack finds himself becoming closer to the agent's female boss.

programme.title: The New Mafia
programme.desc: Sue goes undercover with Tony, a visiting FBI agent, in order to infiltrate a mafia family. But Jack becomes concerned because Tony doesn't always play by the rules.

programme.title: Elvis Is In The Building
programme.desc: Sue and the team must infiltrate an Asian gang, requiring Bobby to go undercover as an Elvis impersonator. Sue learns Troy has an estranged brother who has a secret.

programme.title: Missing
programme.desc: The F.B.I. team's favorite waitress goes missing but what seems like a possible kidnapping case, becomes more complicated.

programme.title: Who Wants To Be A Millionaire?
programme.desc: When a drug-laden plane crashes outside of D.C., Sue and the team must track down the drug smugglers. Meanwhile, annoying office manager Randy has a new job for Sue.

programme.title: The Gambler
programme.desc: Sue's dependence on her hearing dog, Levi, is threatened when Levi gets lost. When Bobby goes undercover as a gambler - the team might lose more than just the next hand.

programme.title: The Lawyer
programme.desc: Sue and the FBI team capture an Al Qaeda leader planning an attack in D.C. A lawyer files a civil right violation against Jack, the terrorist could be let go.

programme.title: The Body Shop
programme.desc: The team tracks a cache of illegal visas and makes a startling discovery. Meanwhile, Sue and Lucy entertain Lucy's cousin who visits and won't leave.

programme.title: He Said, She Said
programme.desc: Sue's special skill of lipreading lands her on an FBI/DEA task force but later finds her credibility, and job, on the line.

programme.title: Secret Agent Man
programme.desc: When a mysterious photo memory stick is delivered to the FBI, Sue and the team must unravel its secrets, leading them on a twisty path to a mysterious stranger.

programme.desc: Sue finds some on the team are not as welcoming to a deaf woman, her unique lipreading ability and her hearing dog Levi as Agent Jack Hudson.

programme.title: The Fugitive
programme.desc: The team goes into high gear when a fugitive escapes from a prison. Sue has misgivings when invited to attend a wedding where she'll come face to face with people from high school.

Interview subjects include Gil Scott-Heron, Spike Lee and Melvin's son and fellow filmmaker, Mario Van Peebles.

programme.desc: Introducing the themes of increasing American power; indigenous political aspirations; conflicting interests and goals; growing mutual antagonism; setting the stage for World War I.

programme.title: Wilson & the Breakup of the Ottoman Empire
programme.desc: An examination of wartime and postwar American policy; showing how Wilson's commitment to an ethnocentrically defined view of national self-determination drives his efforts to shape the postwar settlement in the Middle East.

programme.title: The Interwar Period
programme.desc: American interest in the Middle East between the wars; revealing one's focus shifting in the 1930s to American interest in Saudi Arabian oil; the increasing activism of American Zionism in response to Hitler's persecution of German Jews.

programme.title: U.S. & the Middle East During World War II
programme.desc: United States' entry into World War II alters Americans' conception of the Middle East; the Middle East's geopolitical orientation is now seen as vital to American security.

programme.title: Creation Stories and Why They Matter
programme.desc: The nature of creation stories.

programme.title: Reading Metaphor in Creation Stories
programme.desc: Metaphor and symbol are integral to creation stories, as they form a crucial part of the language of myth.

programme.title: Mesopotamian Creation: Enuma elish
programme.desc: Enuma Elish, also called the Seven Tablets of Creation, is a masterpiece of Mesopotamian literature.

programme.title: The Mesopotamian Flood: The Atrahasis Epic
programme.desc: Examining key Mesopotamian texts referencing a catastrophic flood which decimates humanity.

programme.title: Muslim Empires: Land, Language, Religion
programme.desc: The geographical region known as Greater Middle East; the range of nations and cultures that define it; historical turning points to witness, encompassing conquests, political alliances and Islam's rise; social, intellectual and economic reforms.

programme.title: Muhammad and the Dawn of Islam - 622
programme.desc: Islam's rise is a major turning point; tracing key phases in the life of Muhammad (PBUH); the founding of the faith through his years of opposition; his establishment of Islam as a religious and political entity; the global impact of these events.

programme.title: Arab Invasion of North Africa - 639
programme.desc: The seventh-century Arab invasion of North Africa brings profound change to the entire region; the Arab armies of the newly created Islamic empire try to conquer the territories of Egypt and others; the lasting Arabization and Islamization.

programme.title: Umayyad Caliphate in Damascus - 661
programme.desc: The establishment of the Umayyad Caliphate's capital in Damascus is a key event in early Muslim history; the Umayyads' achievements; locating the empire's capital away from the Arabian Peninsula; the shift from an Islamic empire to imperial power.

programme.title: Bearing Off: The Story of Backgammon
programme.desc: During the Third Crusade, the European soldiers spend the winter playing the ancient game of Tables, which would evolve into backgammon by the 20th century.

programme.title: Senet: Egypt's Game of the Afterlife
programme.desc: Unearthed artifacts from King Tutankhamun's tomb include Senet boards. Historians study the hieroglyphs and investigate the abrupt disappearance of this ancient Egyptian game.

programme.title: Chess: The Evolution of a Strategy Icon
programme.desc: Developed during the Guptas' rule in India, Chaturanga is a strategy game resembling chess. It gradually wended its way westward to become what it is in the present.

programme.title: Chess's Eastern Cousins: Shogi and Xiangqi
programme.desc: The East Asian games of Xiangqi and Shogi are potentially connected to Chaturanga and chess, but a lack of documentation makes it difficult to ascertain anything.

programme.title: American Presidents and the Rule of Law
programme.desc: Exploring the roots of the presidency and presidential power as outlined in the Constitution; the advantages and disadvantages a president has during an investigation; why presidential investigations are essential knowledge for any American citizen.

programme.title: Presidential Investigations through History
programme.desc: Presidential crises and abuses of power; early executive scandals and their significant long-term effects; how people are still dealing with the fallout of famous investigations; the controversies of Ulysses S. Grant and Warren G. Harding.

programme.title: Separation of Powers and the Presidency
programme.desc: Legislative and judicial oversight of the presidency as a permanent part of the American government; limiting and restraining the possibility of executive abuse; how a system of checks and balances came to exist; the case of Marbury v. Madison.

programme.title: Watergate and the Special Prosecutor
programme.desc: The Watergate burglars and how the consequences of their arrest brought down President Richard Nixon; two important Supreme Court cases that shaped a president's power to dismiss personnel; the Independent Counsel Act.

programme.title: Rise and Fall of the Independent Counsel
programme.desc: Why Congress and the public were convinced that an independent investigator was essential; the swing from the Nixon era to the independent counsel of the Reagan and Clinton eras; the special counsel investigating Russian election hacking.

programme.title: Significance and Historical Context
programme.desc: The major players in the debate over the Constitution's ratification; those who take part in the struggle in New York, where thoughtful Anti-Federalist writings are produced; later responded to with Federalist papers organized by Alexander Hamilton.

programme.title: Classical Republicanism
programme.desc: The Anti-Federalists attack the proposed constitutional order; saying it departs too much from the Greco-Roman ideal of virtuous participatory republicanism; the Anti-Federalist objections; their own reservations about classical republicanism.

programme.title: The Anti-Federalists' Republican Vision
programme.desc: The participatory and virtue-centered vision of the Anti-Federalists dictates a more decentralized arrangement than the more consolidated national government proposed by the Federalists; the Federalists' focus on the demands of national security.

programme.title: The Argument over National Security
programme.desc: A need for sound defense and foreign policy; The Federalist critiques the existing constitution; a critique of the inadequacy of confederacies. Anti-Federalists counter by suggesting that Federalists may be falling prey to visions of an empire.

programme.title: Eye for an Eye
programme.desc: A highly trained and exceptionally deadly swordsman looks for revenge after being caught in the middle of a power struggle that results in the assassination of an innocent woman's family.

programme.title: Gundala
programme.desc: Gundala, who has grown up on the streets, must choose between continuing to look out for himself or doing something about the injustice that surrounds him.

programme.title: Champion
programme.desc: A former arm-wrestling champion raised in the U.S. returns to South Korea for a tournament that could return him to glory, but he finds his life complicated by the appearance of the biological family he never knew.

programme.title: Day Zero
programme.desc: A former elite soldier is released from jail only to discover that the outside world has been taken over by a dangerous virus. Chased by hordes of the undead, he fights tooth and nail in a desperate attempt to reach his estranged family.

programme.title: Crazy Samurai: 400 vs. 1
programme.desc: A master samurai, Musashi Miyamoto, battles 400 swordsmen as they challenge his place as the samurai of the century.

programme.title: Paradox

programme.desc: Legends collide as young Yuda wrestles to unlock newfound god-like powers, defending his world in an endless battle against ancient and powerful evils.
