programme.desc: A swordsman who is going blind is forced to raise his sword again to save his daughter, who has been kidnapped by a slave dealer.

programme.title: Baby Assassins
programme.desc: Two high school girls who are about to graduate also happen to be highly-skilled assassins. When the organization that employs them orders them to share a room, their relationship turns sour.

programme.title: Baby Assassins 2
programme.desc: Chisato and Mahiro must pay four years of overdue fees or lose their membership in their assassin guild. They take part-time jobs, but find themselves in the middle of an armed robbery and being hunted by other assassins.

programme.title: Preman: The Silent Fury
programme.desc: After his son witnesses a brutal murder by a notorious crime boss, a deaf Indonesian gangster is thrust into the fight of his life when he takes on his dangerous former allies to protect his child.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: A vengeful crime boss forms an unlikely partnership with a detective, to catch the elusive serial killer who attacked him.

programme.title: Ghost Confessions
programme.desc: The Sherman family's dream life turns into a nightmare when 17-year-old Macy is targeted by a terrifying entity. As her mother and sister experience paranormal activity, their skeptical father remains unconvinced-until he hears an unseen presence speak. With the spirit refusing to leave, the desperate family turns to experts for help before it's too late.

programme.title: Demons Never Die
programme.desc: After moving to the suburbs, Bill and Amanda Toler dismiss eerie noises-until Bill is scratched and Amanda sees an inhuman face. Paranormal investigators uncover a portal in their home and a demon that followed Bill from his job at a penitentiary. In a race against time, they must close the portal and banish the entity before it destroys the family.

programme.title: House of Sorrows
programme.desc: Darrin and Jamie Shriver move into a home where four people died of CO poisoning. Strange sounds and ghostly sightings soon turn sinister-Darrin and their dog are attacked. Paranormal investigators cleanse the home, but Darrin unknowingly invites dark forces back, putting his wife and newborn in grave danger. Can they escape the house's tragic fate?

programme.title: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Strange occurrences in Charles Gonzales' home awaken memories of past paranormal events tied to his uncle's unsolved murder. Seeking answers, he contacts psychic Desiree Page, who warns of a deadly family curse. When a vengeful spirit attacks Charles and his girlfriend, he must confront childhood memories and uncover hidden truths before the entity traps him forever.

programme.title: Love Curse
programme.desc: For years, a dark force stalks Lee Moore in his nightmares. After he and his bride Claire move into their first home, the entity emerges, attacking Claire while she's pregnant. A ghost hunter confirms it's a demon, and experts cleanse the home. But when the hunter returns for an uninvited ritual, Lee falls mysteriously ill. Can demonologists save him before the entity claims his soul?

programme.title: Dark Wrath
programme.desc: Cindy's recurring nightmares of a dark, angry figure intensify as she moves her family to an old house in her rural hometown. Assuming it's just stress, she pushes forward, but soon, her dreams become reality. Her daughters fear their room, and an eerie presence lurks in the shadows. When the entity physically attacks her, Cindy must summon her courage to fight the evil before it harms her family.

programme.title: Demon's Lair
programme.desc: The Cranmer family believes their historic Pittsburgh home is haunted by a harmless ghost-until the activity turns violent. Seeking help from the Catholic Church, they uncover a demon and the home's dark past. As attacks escalate and walls ooze a blood-like substance, they refuse to flee, facing a terrifying battle that culminates in a desperate exorcism.

programme.title: Monster in the Apartment
programme.desc: Morgan Knudson and her friend Bob move into a downtown Edmonton flat, only to discover a dark spirit lurking. While Bob, battling cancer and loneliness, sees a harmless ghostly boy, Morgan senses something sinister. When the entity violently attacks her, she seeks a demonologist who reveals the truth-the spirit is trying to possess Bob, and Morgan must act before it claims his soul.

programme.title: The Awakening
programme.desc: Randy and Marcy, both in law enforcement, face mounting stress when their son is deployed overseas. Marcy's overwhelming fear awakens a dormant spirit that feeds on her anxiety, growing dangerously powerful. As the presence tightens its grip, Marcy must stay calm and find a way to banish the evil force before it drives her to the brink.

programme.title: Gateway To Evil
programme.desc: Devastated by a friend's murder, Julisa holds a séance to communicate one last time--and unwittingly invites a dark spirit into her home...and her life. Julisa and her mother believe that she has re-ignited the evil that plagued her mother years ago.

programme.title: The Possessed
programme.desc: Paranormal investigators risk their own safety to protect others. Mary Vogel, a spiritual counselor, faces a force that shakes her faith. Nightmares consume her, unseen entities attack, and even church feels sinister. A voice whispers, 'Your God can't help you now.' Her mentor, John Zaffis, realizes the truth-Mary is possessed, and only an exorcism can save her soul.

programme.title: Ghost Protector
programme.desc: A mother and daughter both believe their house is haunted. But while the mother believes it's the spirit of her murdered boyfriend, her daughter believes it's much darker. After paranormal experts investigate they uncover an epic battle between good and evil.

programme.title: The Uninvited
programme.desc: Lynn and Jason Ryder purchase a historic Connecticut restaurant, only to be overwhelmed by forces of evil when employees and patrons are attacked. Investigators, mediums and clairvoyants are called in to rid the restaurant of its demonic past.

programme.title: Curse of the Mummy
programme.desc: After a chilling encounter at an Egyptian exhibit, Caleb Weaver is haunted by a relentless entity. Years of torment force him to flee, but when he returns home, the dark force reawakens-stronger than ever. Now, it seeks to possess him and threatens those he loves. With time running out, Caleb turns to a deliverance minister for a final battle against the ancient evil seeking his soul.

programme.title: Mother's Terror
programme.desc: After Jeanette's firefighter husband dies, she moves her daughters to a Long Island hamlet for a fresh start. But eerie discoveries and violent paranormal attacks turn their refuge into a nightmare. Determined to fight back, Jeanette enlists a psychic to uncover the home's dark past and a deliverance minister to confront the relentless evil threatening her family's safety.

programme.title: Spellbound
programme.desc: Sandra Waldron is fascinated by the supernatural, but her son Gene wants no part of it. When they learn their home is haunted, Sandra dives deeper into the paranormal, eventually embracing Wicca. Seeking good fortune, she unknowingly opens a portal to evil. With Gene gone in the military, Sandra must now battle the dark force she unleashed before it consumes her entirely.

programme.title: Echoes of the Past
programme.desc: Libby and Sean Johnson renovate a Vermont home, unaware of its tragic past. Soon, eerie noises fill the night, and their daughter speaks of visiting 'fairies.' As they uncover the home's dark history, ghostly activity escalates to physical attacks. Desperate for answers, Libby turns to paranormal investigators, hoping they can rid the house of restless spirits before it's too late.

programme.title: Echoes from the Grave
programme.desc: Ron and Nancy believe their historic Baltimore home is perfect. But the seller warns, 'I hope you're good fighters.' At first, they battle faulty wiring and strange plumbing issues. Then, objects move on their own, and Nancy dreams of an old woman laughing as their house burns. As the haunting increases, they realize their home is a gateway between life and death-and someone tried to seal it shut.

programme.title: The Calling
programme.desc: Rebecca's new marriage to Daniel seems perfect, but she hides a lifelong secret-she can see and hear spirits. She has always blocked them out, but when a persistent ghost refuses to be ignored, she can no longer run. Forced to confront the entity, Rebecca must trust Daniel and enlist his help to uncover the truth before it threatens their new life together.

programme.title: The Shadowman
programme.desc: As kids, Tim and Tom Yancey love playing in the Florida woods-until a menacing presence begins watching them. When it invades their bedroom, terror traps them in their own home. With no help in sight, the nightmare follows Tim into adulthood. Decades later, he returns to confront the demon that stole his childhood, determined to reclaim his life once and for all.

programme.title: The Presence
programme.desc: Evil thrives on deception, slowly eroding faith and family bonds. Sarah Miller senses something supernatural in her home, terrifying her children and making her question reality. Her boyfriend's skepticism deepens the divide as a demonic force tightens its grip. A religious demonologist identifies a diabolical infestation and prepares a ritual to expel the entity before it destroys them.

programme.title: The Exorcism of Cindy Sauer
programme.desc: Deadly Attachment Georgia single Mom Cindy Sauer tries to get over the sudden death of her husband when dark shadows and nightmares convince her that a demon is haunting her and her family. Cindy turns to a Pastor to exorcise the entity before it drives them literally insane.

programme.title: A Haunting in Florida
programme.desc: Some places are charged with psychic energy, still traveled by spirits that haven't passed on. Edd and Beth's new home seems ideal, but soon they see a transparent man, a misty old woman, and a growing dark cloud. As supernatural forces intensify, a paranormal investigator confirms their fears. Their home is a portal, filled with enough negative energy to erupt into something terrifying.

programme.title: Deaths Door
programme.desc: Victoria Dane of New Mexico awakens from a near-­death experience to discover she is being attacked by a dark, demonic entity. With the help of investigators, she soon realizes she has opened a door to a paranormal world that may never be shut.

programme.title: When the Lights Go Out
programme.desc: After newlyweds Brooke and Dominic Ardolino experience strange paranormal events in their home, they call in investigators who uncover two spirits - one is trying to warn them while the other is dangerous.

programme.title: Living Nightmare
programme.desc: After marrying Stephen, Angela's childhood nightmares return-only now, the old hag from her dreams appears in waking life. She dismisses it as anxiety until the entity terrorizes her daughter and briefly possesses her son. Realizing the threat is real, Angela, at Stephen's urging, turns to paranormal investigators to fight the relentless evil before it destroys their family.

programme.title: Stalked by Evil
programme.desc: Judy McCarthy hopes for a fresh start in Texas, but a shadowy presence emerges in their home. It fixates on her teenage daughter, Caressa, tormenting her each night. As the entity grows stronger, Judy fights to protect her family. When she uncovers the home's violent past, she realizes the spirit is intent on keeping Caressa trapped-and she must act before it's too late.

programme.title: Hell House
programme.desc: In this world, evil lurks in both shadows and unassuming places. It deceives and destroys. When Bonnie's family buys a 19th-century Connecticut farmhouse, they feel watched. After unseen entities attack her children, they seek out psychic investigators. As events grow violent, Bonnie forms a psychic link to the past, and investigators witness the haunting escalate from obsession to possession.

programme.title: House of the Dead
programme.desc: Children often feel powerless in the face of the adult world. In Glen Burnie, Maryland, 10-year-old Billy Bean's life is already in crisis. He and his sister are attacked at night-pinned to their beds by unseen forces. Billy senses an evil presence destroying his family. As the attacks worsen, he fights to uncover the dark secrets of the house on Little Road before he loses everything.

programme.title: The Attic
programme.desc: Some believe knowledge comes from reason, others from intuition. When Selena moves into an old Michigan house, she senses danger. The attic makes her dizzy, the kitchen feels watched, and photos reveal ghostly faces. With proof of a haunting, she and her sister seek a psychic's help. He confirms the worst-the house is a place of suffering, trapping both the living and the dead.

programme.title: The Unleashed
programme.desc: Some Native American myths tell of supernatural creatures guarding the dead. Early explorers spoke of werewolves and the Wendigo. When Randy discovers a Native American skeleton beneath his home, he recites an incantation, hoping to make contact. Soon, a cold, growling monster appears, attacking his loved ones. The spirits don't want the house-they want him, and they won't let go.

programme.title: Darkness Follows
programme.desc: Some bonds can't be broken-like a mother's love or a killer's grip on his victim. Al, Kellie, and her daughter Hailey move into a Montreal townhouse, aware of its tragic past. A teen girl, evicted with her mother, took her own life. But death wasn't the end. Haunting audio recordings reveal she has returned-with a follower. As Al obsesses over a past murder, Kellie fears a killer still lurks.

programme.title: Shape of Evil
programme.desc: Jay Yaple moves his family into a fixer-upper in Enfield, CT, unaware of its dark history. Unexplained events soon turn into terrifying attacks, and Jay realizes a malevolent entity is targeting them. Anyone who tries to help is driven away by the demon. Trapped and desperate, the family turns to an exorcist as their last hope-but will it be enough to break the entity's hold?

programme.title: Phantom Room
programme.desc: Shari and Erol's new California home seems perfect-until they discover a hidden room in the garage. Strange events follow, but while Shari believes the house is haunted, Erol remains skeptical. When the ghost becomes violent, Shari seeks help from a psychic, who uncovers an angry spirit determined to drive them out. Can they reclaim their home before the ghost tears their family apart?

programme.title: Conjuring Evil
programme.desc: Harold and Cindy's peaceful Alaskan retreat turns into a nightmare when their daughter unknowingly invites a dark entity through witchcraft. What starts as small disturbances escalates into violent attacks, even hospitalizing Cindy's mother. A skeptic, Harold investigates and uncovers the terrifying truth. With their family in danger, they call in experts to reclaim their home.

programme.title: Fear Feeders
programme.desc: After buying a home near Fort Wayne, Al Gonzalez hears strange noises and sees shadows but keeps quiet, fearing no one will believe him. When entities torment him day and night-mimicking a deceased loved one-he seeks help. Investigators confirm the house is infested with dangerous spirits, and Al realizes he may not be their first victim.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: Chris and Roseann Cupit find comfort in the spirit of Chris' late grandmother watching over their Arkansas home. But her presence is a warning-a relentless demon has targeted their daughter, tormenting her with night terrors and attacks. Desperate, they seek help from their pastor, but he refuses. Turning to a paranormal team and a demonologist, they prepare for a battle to save their family.

programme.title: Hidden Terror
programme.desc: Living together requires balance, but Mike and Lisa aren't alone in their new home. Lisa's behavior changes inexplicably, and Mike grows desperate for answers. A late-night encounter with an invisible force convinces him they are haunted. He sets up surveillance, watching and waiting. What he captures shakes him to the core-are ghosts real, or is he losing his mind?

programme.title: Masks of Terror
programme.desc: After Jeanette Osborne decorates her home with Haitian masks, eerie events escalate, leading her son Grier to believe they are cursed. When an unseen force attacks him, Jeanette seeks help from a voodoo priest and paranormal expert John Zaffis. As malevolent energy threatens her family, Jeanette must confront the spirits' wrath before their home becomes a place of irreversible terror.

programme.title: The Diabolical
programme.desc: How would reality change if we couldn't perceive or communicate in conventional ways? For Marie, this question is daily life. Her daughter Julie, unable to walk or talk, interacts with unseen forces. Marie wonders if they're angels-until she comes face to face with a demon. A Ouija board session turns their home into a portal for darkness, proving that evil can lurk in the most ordinary places.

programme.title: Demon Unearthed
programme.desc: Jennifer and Norman Rice buy a historic mansion in Garden Grove, Iowa, but renovations uncover eerie rumors of a buried body. As the paranormal activity intensifies, Jennifer and their son are tormented while Norman is away. When he returns, he too falls victim to the evil force. Even the church's blessing fails, forcing the family to flee their dream home before it destroys them.

programme.title: Heartland Horror
programme.desc: Teenager Nolan Lydolph has seen ghosts all his life, but after a ghost tour in Branson, MO, his family's Iowa farmhouse becomes plagued by sinister shadows. When attacks turn violent, Nolan and his mother call paranormal investigator Wesley Fox. He and his psychic wife uncover a calculating demon targeting Nolan, forcing him into a life-threatening battle for survival.

programme.title: Demon Whispers
programme.desc: When Phil Pritchard's beloved father dies, he falls into a deep depression that renders him vulnerable to an unearthly evil that begins influencing him and will stop at nothing to render him a pawn in its relentless thirst for misery and murder.

programme.title: Dark Dreams
programme.desc: Michigan attorney Chris Gibbons and his family move into their dream house, which quickly becomes a nightmare. A bizarre combination of terrifying dreams and ghost sightings force Chris to do battle with the supernatural.

programme.title: The Lake Club Horror
programme.desc: In Springfield, Illinois, the Lake Club was once a lively dance hall where fortunes were won and lost. In 1974, Bill and Tom transform it into a rock club and soon uncover eerie secrets. Phantom music and chilling cold spots make them believe they are not alone. Others share their fears, and a young woman receives a ghostly warning: one of the owners is about to die.

programme.title: Fear House
programme.desc: Childhood fear is pure, untempered by adult rationality. After his divorce, Steven LaChance dismisses his children's nightmares as stress-until he experiences chilling disturbances himself. Shadows lurk, screams echo, and an unseen force preys on them. He flees, but when another family moves in, he vows to help them. If you enter the spirit world, the spirits enter yours.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: When Sidney's girlfriend moves in, he and his mother, Jaime, experience disturbing events, escalating from eerie calls to physical attacks. They soon discover an ex-friend is using witchcraft to tear them apart. As Jaime becomes the target of a deadly assault, the family, fearing for their lives, seeks the help of paranormal investigators before the dark forces succeed in their sinister plan.

programme.title: Tunnel of Death
programme.desc: After Candace and John St. Clair visit a haunted tunnel where slaves were buried alive, something follows them home. Their daughter has terrifying nightmares, dishes shatter, and the entity soon turns violent. Attacked and terrified, they call paranormal experts to cleanse their home-before they're forced to flee from the malevolent presence.

programme.title: Mind Control
programme.desc: In 2012, Amanda Morrisson and her family clean a relative's home to fund his care but uncover satanic objects. Soon, they face terrifying events-Nate sees shadows, David has nightmares, and Alliah spirals into depression. When Amanda encounters a sinister entity, they seek a demonologist, who traces the haunting to an evil necklace David took from the house.

programme.title: Ghost Hunter
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Stacy Jones feels confident letting her son Jamie join her at a cemetery investigation. But after returning home, Jamie finds strange scratches on his leg and experiences terrifying activity-objects flying and unseen forces attacking him. When Stacy witnesses a demonic assault on her son, she calls in expert John Zaffis to help save Jamie from possession.

programme.title: Game of Lies
programme.desc: In 2012, Olivia and Jesse Barbour's daughter Marie befriends a boy named Jackson-who isn't real. At first harmless, Jackson soon frightens Marie, leaving bruises and urging her to follow him to heaven. When she's found with red marks on her neck, the family seeks help. Investigators reveal Jackson is a cruel spirit-an old man disguised as a boy to torment Marie.

programme.desc: While preparing their late friend Paul's house for sale, Anita Intenzo and her son Chris encounter his spirit-along with something much darker. When a violent entity attacks Chris, Anita seeks help. A medium warns of a demon linked to a mysterious artifact Paul acquired abroad. As chaos erupts in their home, Anita and Chris must locate the artifact before the demon destroys them.

programme.desc: JoJo and Tanice find themselves in a marriage crisis when JoJo's stood up on a group date; Tee Tee and Shawn's wedding plans spiral out of control; Sam seeks guidance from Layzie; danger strikes for Briana when police come knocking at her door.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Bullied at school, neglected at home and incredibly lonely, 12-year-old Owen (Kodi Smit-McPhee) spends his days plotting revenge on his tormentors and spends his nights spying on other residents of the apartment complex. His sole friend is Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz), a strange girl who comes out only at nighttime. Both outcasts, the two form a strong bond. When Abby's caretaker disappears amid a series of gruesome murders, Owen begins to suspect that she is hiding a terrible secret.

programme.title: Begin Again
programme.desc: Gretta and her songwriting partner/lover Dave head for New York when he lands a record deal with a major label. However, Gretta is suddenly left on her own when Dave gives in to the temptations that come with his newfound success. Things take a turn for the better for her when Dan, a disgraced record executive, discovers Gretta performing in a club. A mutually life-changing bond forms between the pair as they work together on Gretta's first album.

programme.title: Blindsided
programme.desc: A killer (Michael Keaton) terrorizes a blind woman (Michelle Monaghan) in her New York penthouse after murdering her boyfriend.

programme.title: Quartet
programme.desc: Once-popular opera diva Jean Horton (Maggie Smith) creates a stir with her arrival at Beecham House, a home for retired performers. No one feels the uproar more than Reginald (Tom Courtenay), Jean's ex-husband, who still stings from her long-ago infidelity. Most of the other Beecham residents are delighted, and try to convince Jean to join them in a performance of "Rigoletto." Jean, however, knows that she is long past her prime and is reluctant to sully the memory of her once-lovely voice.

programme.title: Jackie's Back!
programme.desc: A British documentarian (Tim Curry) profiles a washed-up diva (Jenifer Lewis) as she prepares for her comeback concert.

programme.title: She's Back
programme.desc: Killed by local punks, a man's (Robert Joy) wife (Carrie Fisher) comes back to lead him and a landfill operator (Matthew Cowles) in revenge.

programme.title: I Don't Know How She Does It
programme.desc: As an employee at a Boston-based financial firm, Kate Reddy (Sarah Jessica Parker) struggles daily to balance the demands of her high-powered career with the needs of her husband (Greg Kinnear) and children. When she gets an account that requires frequent trips to New York and her husband gets a new job, Kate finds herself spread even thinner. Complicating Kate's life even more is new business associate Jack Abelhammer (Pierce Brosnan), who throws temptation into the mix.

programme.title: Expecting
programme.desc: Lizzie's best friend, Andie, becomes pregnant and offers to give the baby to her. Lizzie's husband, Peter, reluctantly goes along with being the child's father, and Andie moves into the guest room for the remainder of the pregnancy.

programme.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
programme.desc: Mother Nature (Saoirse Ronan) loves to cause mischief, and she steps in to help two love-starved souls find happiness. She helps an aging professional woman (Michelle Pfeiffer) who has no luck with love find her match with a much younger man (Paul Rudd). As their relationship blossoms into something beyond physical attraction, her adolescent daughter (Tracey Ullman) begins to question the tingling sensations she experiences whenever she is in the company of a handsome local boy.

programme.title: Freeway
programme.desc: Following the arrest of her mother, Ramona (Amanda Plummer), young Vanessa Lutz (Reese Witherspoon) decides to go in search of her estranged grandmother. On the way, she is given a ride by school counselor Bob Wolverton (Kiefer Sutherland). During the journey, Lutz begins to realize that Bob is the notorious I-5 Killer and manages to escape by shooting him several times. Wounded but still very much alive, Bob pursues Lutz across the state in this modern retelling of Little Red Riding Hood.

programme.title: True Crime
programme.desc: Mary (Alicia Silverstone), a precocious high school senior, longs to be a cop. She idolizes her late father, a policeman, and intently studies her favorite magazine, "True Crime." When a classmate dies and the case remains unsolved, Mary becomes obsessed, pestering a local cop (Bill Nunn). When she meets police cadet Tony (Kevin Dillon), the two decide to take up the investigation themselves, and romantic sparks soon fly. But Mary has no idea of the danger that awaits her.

While in his hometown, Jon's daughter, Michelle (Hilary Swank), makes friends with some of the local girls as well as someone named Tony Reno (Alexis Arquette), who resembles and has the same name as one of the boys her father killed.

programme.title: Georgia Rule
programme.desc: Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

programme.title: Fierce People
programme.desc: Finn (Anton Yelchin) is a teenager trying to escape his drug-addicted mother (Diane Lane) by going to study tribal people. His hopes are dashed when he gets caught scoring drugs for her, and she decides to start their lives over by moving them in with her massage client, billionaire Ogden (Donald Sutherland). At first, Finn indulges in the luxury around him and falls for Ogden's granddaughter (Kristen Stewart), but he soon finds that the rich can be more savage than any group in the wild.

programme.title: Father-in-law's Junk
programme.desc: Kraig Bantle and his crew of clean-out specialists help Mary Joyce rid a garage of her father-in-law's junk. Can the Garage Brothers turn this bizarre collection into extra earnings? Ron has faith that the job will pan out, especially after unveiling a strange Bible and a set of old-fashioned dinner bells.

programme.title: Big Plans, Bad Luck
programme.desc: Mikey decides to get Buffalo involved in a D-Day paratrooper jump to commemorate the 70th anniversary of D-Day.

programme.title: UPS Worldport, Channel Islands delivery, Sculpture, EMA fire drill
programme.desc: Mega Air gets privileged access to the world's biggest air package handling facility at UPS Worldport.

programme.title: Southern Waters
programme.desc: When Air Station Clearwater responds to a distress signal in the Gulf of Mexico, they find themselves in a standoff with the vessel in distress.

programme.title: Botanist & Tocador (Vancouver)
programme.desc: Kyle heads to the beautiful area of Coal Harbour in downtown Vancouver where he enters the luxurious Fairmont Pacific Rim Hotel. Inside the Botanist, Kyle meets with the Creative Beverage Director Grant Sceney and bartender Justin Powell. The next stop is Tocador, a Latin-inspired cocktail bar in Mount Pleasant. Bartender Stewart Hawthorne introduces Kyle to some very original exotic cocktails.

programme.title: New Orleans Indy
programme.desc: It's the first ever Indy race in the Big Easy, but staging a race during raining season in New Orleans will be anything but easy. Three-time Indy 500 Champ Helio Castroneves is anxious to make his mark on the brand new track, but heavy rains will provide a supreme challenge. The track is below sea level so drainage is almost non-existent.

programme.title: A Haunted Hospital
programme.desc: On this episode of Paranormal Encounters, Connor and India travel to South Pittsburg, TN to investigate the Old South Pittsburg Hospital Paranormal Research Center. Joined by a special guest, the trio discover that the ghost stories about this haunted hospital hold a lot more truth than most would like to believe.

programme.title: A Haunted Mansion
programme.desc: On this episode of Paranormal Encounters, Connor and India travel to Winchester, Indiana to investigate the historic Stone Mansion. What they expect to be a quiet night turns into one of the most compelling investigations in a long while as they converse with the other side. They quickly find that what they capture backs up the paranormal claims other visitors have experienced inside this haunted mansion.

programme.title: A Brother's Love
programme.desc: Two brothers struggle to break a lethal cycle of crime and stick together when one is sent behind bars.

programme.title: Fashion Weak
programme.desc: Ingrid Levin invites Kendra and her friends to New Yorkʼs Fashion Week.

programme.title: The Unkindest Cut
programme.desc: Kendra rushes home for Hankʼs season opener only to find out that Hankʼs been cut by the Eagles.

programme.title: Interception
programme.desc: Kendra begins to find out what being an "NFL wife" is all about.

programme.title: American Hero
programme.desc: Follow the career of a retired African American LAPD as he worked in the city of Angels during its most troubling times. From his humble beginnings in Compton to his time in SWAT and as a Hollywood adviser, his story is an uplifting tale of overcoming adversity to protect and serve.

programme.title: Poltergeist House
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension investigate a Poltergeist haunting a homeowner who is a wits end. Poltergeistal activity in the home is terrorizing the tenant and paranormal investigators Bex and Sean are about to start the exorcism of this demonic entity away for good.

programme.title: Cadborosaurus, Yowie, and the Tasmanian Tiger
programme.desc: Discover the truth behind Cadborosaurus, Yowie, and the Tasmanian Tiger.

programme.title: Whatever Happened to Baby Jayde
programme.desc: Holly helps get Angel a modeling gig as a Bunny for a Playboy Club promotional ad

programme.title: Single And Successful 107: Dont Underestimate the Small Things
programme.desc: The ladies learn a powerful lesson about how small issues can quickly escalate to big problems. With the help of a spooky trip to a miniature golf course, these ladies find out just how complicated a simple task can become.

programme.title: A&E - AFTER DARK - S03E03
programme.desc: The night staff at Hull Royal Infirmary battle to save the sight of 51-year-old Patricia, who tripped and impaled her eye on a tent peg. With her vision impaired, a CT scan reveals a bleed on the brain that requires the intervention of neurosurgeon Dr Kenneth. Plus, a patient is flown in by air ambulance after falling down a ditch in her mobility scooter.

programme.title: Semper Paratus
programme.desc: Air Station Miami rescues a six year-old boy with a possible burst appendix and during the Covid Pandemic, a passenger is evacuated from a cruise.

programme.title: Episode 5: Edmonton
programme.desc: If there's one thing Edmonton's known for, it's big auctions! And this year's spring sale is no exception. With the site's current three-day sales record sitting at 109 million dollars, staff are looking to blow that figure out of the water with the biggest auction to ever hit Canada.

programme.title: Killer Whales - Season 2: "Community Special" Episode 5
programme.desc: As voted by the viewers, these tech startups have a unique chance to pitch to the 'Killer Whales' judges. Can they stay focused and keep their eyes on the $1,500,000 prize pool, or will the pressure be too much and they leave empty-handed

programme.title: Cry Baby Gallery & Project Gigglewater (Toronto)
programme.desc: Welcome to Toronto's Cry Baby Gallery. Kyle joins bartender Yuri Kuroiwa to sample their famous Zombie cocktail. It is a cocktail with many different flavours, a perfect mix of sweet, sour and spicy. Kyle savours other top cocktails before making his way to Project Gigglewater where Kyle meets owner Andrew Siu and samples classic tequila-based cocktails and tropical drinks.

programme.title: Dark Arts & Shokunin (Calgary)
programme.desc: Kyle drops by the Dark Arts, a former pop-up cocktail bar in Calgary. Jason Ishak prepares drinks for Kyle that are a Work of Art. Kyle makes his way to Shokunin, an Authentic Japanese Restaurant owned by award-winning Chef Darren MacLean. Kyle jokes and speaks with bartender, Christiaan Heerema, who mixes up a Park Hyatt in The Mist, a classic Japanese bourbon-based favourite.

programme.title: Botanist & Tocador (Vancouver)
programme.desc: Kyle heads to the beautiful area of Coal Harbour in downtown Vancouver where he enters the luxurious Fairmont Pacific Rim Hotel. Inside the Botanist, Kyle meets with the Creative Beverage Director Grant Sceney and bartender Justin Powell. The next stop is Tocador, a Latin-inspired cocktail bar in Mount Pleasant. Bartender Stewart Hawthorne introduces Kyle to some very original exotic cocktails.

programme.title: Weakest to Strongest Spider-Man in GTA 5!
programme.desc: Only the strong survive in Spider Gwen's love life and Bloo must bulk up to become the friendly neighborhood Muscle-Man.

programme.title: Stealing $50,000,000 Car in GTA 5!
programme.desc: Bloo must steal back his fleet of expensive cars from Doctor Eggman.

programme.title: The Longhorn Goodbye
programme.desc: The remaining 6 cowboys face off in a cutting competition that turns out to be more difficult than expected. Then, they work as a team to sort 4 rogue cattle from a herd and load them on a trailer. Host Trace Adkins and the judges send a cowboy home.

programme.title: Family Loses All to Katrina
programme.desc: Anita is suing her son, John, for damages done to the family minivan when she says he took it out for a drive without a license and got into an accident.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Everyday office workers are throw into harsh conditions for an adventure for their survival.

programme.title: Unforgettable
programme.desc: Rob visits some rescued pit bulls as they go through K-9 police training; Danielle says goodbye to a long-term resident.

programme.title: Second Chances
programme.desc: Rob assesses a dog at risk of being put down; Tony and Moby gain some interest from families.

programme.title: Barry's Big Day
programme.desc: Dr. Barry prepares for his biggest day yet as he opens his own veterinary clinic. But first, he must help a Cuban rescue dog--and go to extreme measures to try to save a pair of injured fawns.

programme.title: When Dogs Bite
programme.desc: After a dog suffers a gruesome bite, Dr. Jessica must make a tough choice. Meanwhile, Dr. Barry rushes offsite to save the life of an owl with a badly injured wing.

programme.title: Higher Ground
programme.desc: Athena regrets moving in with James. Sharise's doting sparks her son's jealousy. Over-chatty Carrie bonds with Sharise over boys and booze, and secrets slip that could land them in hot water.

programme.title: Spanking Scandals
programme.desc: Monica wrote to Dr. Phil because she says she has to discipline her four children every day out of anger. She spanks them, has hit them with a belt, made them miss meals, tied their hands together until they professed to like each other - even leaving belt marks on her son out of anger. Her husband admits to spanking the kids, too, at times. Also, we meet Elizabeth who pulled her 12-year old son out of school after he was "paddled" as a form of punishment.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Zak treats a 90-year-old woman after paramedics give her CPR; Tristan gets a diagnosis spot-on; Christine has a patient with an alarming combination of symptoms.

programme.title: Coal, Sunseeker Yacht, Shoreham Divers
programme.desc: An inside look at the largest freight operator.

programme.title: Service Above Self
programme.desc: Air Station Miami performs their annual wet drills, then a look back at some of the season's cases, and the loss of one of their own.

programme.title: Cheetahs of the Desert
programme.desc: Dr. Chris Brown visits Namibia and works with cheetahs at a wildlife sanctuary and visits an injured baboon.

programme.title: Memphis Part 2: Dark Skies and Jet Trucks
programme.desc: Julie Clark's hopes for a make-up flight are jeopardized.

programme.title: Steak 'n' Kimchi Mac 'n' Cheese
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Steak 'n' Kimchi Mac 'n' Cheese! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Croque Madame
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Croque Madame! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Cabinteely / Wellington, New Zealand
programme.desc: Our contributors are Mother and Son, Liz and James. James has been living in Wellington for 14 years now and lives with his wife Ani.

programme.title: Ta'Rhonda Jones and Lance Gross
programme.desc: Patti LaBelle has star power in her kitchen today. First, Ta'Rhonda Jones drops by to learn Patti's delicious Pork Chops with Sauteed Cabbage. Then, Patti refreshes her palate with actress Kaitlin Doubleday over a vegan lunch of Sauteed Portobello Mushrooms with Garlic and Butter. Finally, Patti is joined by actor Lance Gross, to help her prepare Pan-Seared Salmon served with Sauteed Green Beans "A La Bella."

programme.title: Kirk Franklin and Erica Campbell
programme.desc: Patti LaBelle introduces long-time friend and gospel superstar, Kirk Franklin, and his wife, Tammy, to her Famous Fried Chicken. Nothing says "yum" like golden-brown, delicious fried chicken served with Sauteed Potatoes and Onions, along with Garlicky Broccoli Rabe. Later, Erica Campbell, from the legendary gospel duo Mary Mary, stops by and she and Patti make a simple and delicious double-layer Peach Cobbler.

programme.title: Kym Whitley and Ledisi
programme.desc: Patti LaBelle invites funny girl Kym Whitley over for a family-style meal including roasted Cornish hens stuffed with her famous "Don't Block the Blessing" Dressing served with an oven-roasted vegetable medley. It's all about food, family and fun as these two eat a little and laugh a lot. Patti takes singer-songwriter Ledisi back to her New Orleans roots with a slamming shrimp creole dish -- a meal so good they both have to sing about it.

programme.title: Brooke Burke
programme.desc: Brooke gets candid about her career in entertainment, including her favorite gig and her firing from Dancing with the Stars.

programme.title: Cambodia
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay leaves his hectic professional life behind him as he embarks on a pilgrimage for fresh flavors in Cambodia.

programme.title: Scallops & Pork
programme.desc: Chefs Erica and Josh Karbelnik go head-to-head to see who can come up with the more tantalizing dish! The catch? Each of their plates must prominently feature both scallops and pork tenderloin!

programme.title: Gemini
programme.desc: Chef Siobhan is all in for Gemini! She starts with a duo of appetizers as an homage to the sign of the twins: Yellow Beet Hummus and Mussels Escabeche. The next dish continues the theme of duality: Corn Two Ways! A creamy corn puree and a fried corn fritter! Next, a pizza for when you can't make up your mind. Half classic margherita, half gorgonzola, duck confit and pear. Finally, Geminis like chef Siobhan like to turn things on their heads, like her dessert of a Pineapple Upside-Down Cake!

programme.title: Pozolillo with the Flack Family
programme.desc: With an aromatic broth of poblano and tomatillo, pozolillo is the perfect comfort food. Tessa utilizes a variety of fresh and unexpected ingredients in her version of this Mexican classic. But will it hold up to her mama's more traditional take?

programme.title: Guyana
programme.desc: Discover the world through some of the most delicious and unusual dishes from countries like China, Morocco and Venezuela. In each episode, we will explore colourful local markets, discovering new flavours and regional produce. The ingredients we find will form the basis for some very special dishes that are simple to make at home.

Clam and Scallion Risotto, is a delicious variation of the beloved Linguine with Clams.

programme.title: Super Simple Seared Lamb Chops
programme.desc: Grilled lamb chops are always delicious but n this episode, Ldiia sears them in a heavy skillet, pressing them down so that all the surface get crisp. She serves the chops with a simple yet elegant red wine sauce with dried cherries, garlic and bay leaves and rosemary. Served with a Tasty Potato Salad and finished with beautiful Almond and Coffee Cream Mini Tarts, this is a meal that everyone will love!

programme.title: The Future of Food
programme.desc: The figure might bring urban farming, veganism and insect protein production.

programme.title: episode 1
programme.desc: In the first episode, Rory prepares kale kroth with lemon and parmesan, grilled chicken with marjoram and lemon and roasted almond sauce; and a delicious dessert of yogurt and star anise cream.

programme.title: episode 5
programme.desc: Scrambled eggs with smoked salmon or wild mushrooms on grilled sourdough bread. Lamb koftas and rocket salad with buttermilk dressing, roast hazelnuts and cumin and chilli oil. Chocolate and caramel mouse with caramel sauce and raspberries.

programme.title: A Moveable Feast with America's Favorite Chefs
programme.desc: Join Jose Andres, Lidia Bastianich, Rick Bayless, Chris Kimball, Ruth Reichl and Ming Tsai as each chef cooks up a single course, shares memorable stories and samples each other's dishes at a one-of-a-kind progressive dinner party.

programme.title: Cajun Night
programme.desc: Vanessa plans a cajun-themed menu with a table to match! There's chili-garlic-cilantro shrimp, fajita rice, cornbread, tomato salad, and so much more!

programme.title: Cooking With Beef
programme.desc: Host Dez Daniels and Manitoba Beef Producers' Anna Borys make 4 delicious recipes: Flaky Pizza Roll with Sweet & Spicy Italian Beef Sausage, Ginger Beef Egg Rolls, Carne Asada Nachos, Pulled Beef Sliders with Mango Fennel Slaw.

programme.title: Tuna Casserole
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Tuna Casserole! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Cape Town to Sligo
programme.desc: Our Tastes Like Home episode is a little different this week as we are looking at the life of someone who's moved away from her home in South Africa and is now living in Sligo, Catherine travels to Capetown, in South Africa to learn how to cook "Cape Malay Curries" so she can cook one for Berenice when she returns to Ireland.

programme.title: Dining with Geishas
programme.desc: Rural Japan: Tony decides to look for a more relaxing, traditional Japanese culinary experience in the countryside. Tony travels to an old-style Japanese inn that specializes in kaiseki cuisine, ancient tea ceremony, and local ingredients.

programme.title: Los Angeles, My Own Heart of Darkness
programme.desc: Los Angeles - CA, New York chef, Anthony Bourdain, descends into the culinary underbelly of his metropolitan nemesis, Los Angeles, where he experiences the trials of celebrity fame and the joys of West Coast cuisine.

programme.title: A Pleasing Palate
programme.desc: London, England - In London, Tony attempts to dispel the myth that all English food is disgusting and over-boiled. Tony tries Nose to Tail Eating, explores traditional fare at Pie and Mash Shoppes and then visits a predominantly Indian community.

programme.title: Spice + Fat
programme.desc: Co-hosts Shahir Massoud and Jasmin Ibrahim explore the relationship between spices and fats in three rich recipes. Juicy watermelon gets treated two ways: as a sauce and as a spicy pickle, both to top a caraway-infused Panna Cotta! Next, a lesson in infusing spice into compound butters: a zingy Za'atar and Lemon Butter for bread and a smoky Paprika and Bay Butter for Grilled Steak! Finally, flaky cod gets basted in juniper and rosemary butter before being sat on a bed of du puy lentils!

programme.title: Comfort + Spice
programme.desc: From Fettuccine Alfredo to Meatloaf, everyday recipes are enjoyed every day for a reason: we love them! Chefs Shahir Massoud and Jasmin Ibrahim use spices to punch up these classic recipes. Meatloaf gets aromatic allspice, and is topped with bay leaf spiked ketchup. Fettuccine gets mustard; both the seed and the leafy green! Bacon and fried rice are ultimate comfort foods, but have you ever tried it with cardamom in the mix? Spice is the secret, a pinch of spice can make a world of difference!

programme.title: Moore Place Revisited
programme.desc: Has Ramsay's fast-track guide to restaurant success helped these brewery whiz-kids transform their failing ex-Berni Inn into a profitable business? And is the building still painted that disgusting shade of purple?

programme.title: Sunday Lunch
programme.desc: For many of us, we savor our hearty Sunday lunches at our favorite pub, and Tom would like to show us how to make them even more special. He starts with a classic roast beef, and ends with a lemon posset pudding, and a chocolate ale cake.

programme.title: Outdoor Food
programme.desc: We all enjoy eating outdoors in a beer garden, and Tom wants to show us how to create outdoor food properly. Chicken in a basket with a twist, a tasty fish burger, a delicious maple cake, extra special barbecued beef ribs... it is chow time.

programme.title: Pasta
programme.desc: There's nothing like a dish of pasta. Made from just flour, eggs, and water-these three simple ingredients can transform into over 350mouthwateringshapes-and thousands of delicious dishes. Regardless of which one is your favorite, pasta-in all of its many forms-is one of the most recognizable foods in the world. It's known as a traditional Italian comfort food-and regarded by chefs as a dish that fosters unlimited creativity.

programme.title: Giant Eel
programme.desc: Iron Chef Morimoto faces another traditionalist who is infamous for his temper, his steadfast discipline and his adherence to tradition.

programme.title: Peach
programme.desc: The challenger in this battle of peach is Masanobu Watabe, owner of Le Rameau d'Or in Yokohama, Japan. Watabe runs the entire 22-seat restaurant by himself.

programme.title: Pecan Sticky Buns and Savory with Nancy Silverton
programme.desc: Nancy Silverton, one of America's noted bread bakers, prepares twice-baked brioche, savory brioche pockets, pecan sticky buns and brioche tart with white secret sauce.

programme.title: Bagels with Lauren Groveman
programme.desc: Lauren Groveman, founder of Lauren Groveman's Kitchen, Inc., prepares bagels, matzos and pumpernickel loaves.

programme.title: Chef Eric's Culinary Classroom
programme.desc: Join world-renowned Chef Eric Crowley for his first Masterclass video series inspiring you to feel confident in the kitchen with several spectacular dishes that are easy to create.

programme.title: City Palace Jaipur
programme.desc: What delicious aromas! Coriander, cinnamon, cloves and, of course, chilli. The young Maharajah of Jaipur loves traditional Indian cuisine.

programme.title: El Rincón
programme.desc: The "Semana Santa" belongs to Marqués de Griñón and his family. During the Holy Week, simple meals are traditionally served but the Count has invited the cultural and social elite of Madrid for a Gala Dinner to El Rincon.

programme.title: The Snail Caviar Dish

programme.title: London Has Fallen
programme.desc: When a national day of mourning in London for a fallen leader turns into a horrific terrorist attack, the clock begins ticking for Mike Banning, a seasoned Secret Service agent, and President Asher. What starts as a solemn funeral quickly devolves into chaos as heavily armed insurgents storm the event, resulting in unprecedented violence across the city. Banning, determined to save the President, navigates through a landscape filled with misinformation and danger, uncovering a deeper conspiracy led by the vengeful arms dealer Aamir Barkawi, whose ties to global terrorism threaten more than just the safety of those physically present. With the breakdown of communication channels and infiltration of key security measures, the protagonist must rely on quick thinking and adrenaline-fueled action to outsmart the enemy. The lives of countless civilians are at stake as Banning engages in a tense battle against time, aiming not only to rescue the President but also to dismantle a profoundly dangerous network designed to sow chaos and destruction worldwide. As the crisis unfolds, it becomes more than just a fight for survival; it's a terrifying examination of the fragility of peace and the price of freedom in a convoluted world.

programme.desc: Michael Symon shares comprehensive garlic education on this Halloween-themed episode of Chewed Up, demonstrating proper peeling methods using a bowl-shaking technique, various cutting approaches including microplane mincing and hand-slicing, and the benefits of removing garlic germs to reduce bitterness. The episode culminates with preparation of luxurious Robuchon-style mashed potatoes—equal parts potatoes and butter—garnished with roasted garlic cloves, Parmigiano-Reggiano, fresh chives, and served alongside grilled garlic bread.

programme.title: Why'd They Wear That?
programme.desc: Clinton Kelly and Stacy London break down the costume design and fashion moments from Mike Nichols' 1988 film "Working Girl," starring Melanie Griffith, Sigourney Weaver, and Harrison Ford. The hosts explore how Ann Roth's costume choices—from Tess's working-class Staten Island attire to her polished corporate wardrobe—reflect her transformation from secretary to executive. programme.title: Curious Traveler

Scott Fitzgerald and Thomas Edison all stay in a hotel where it looks like the roof is melting? And how did Scots-Irish immigrants create American country music?

programme.title: Cooking School
programme.desc: "Chicken Pot Pie from scratch in 45 minutes?! REAL-TIME COOKING" - After a long day of filming in the studio kitchen, Dave Chang wanted one more challenge. For no reason other than to see if he could do it, he attempted the utterly ridiculous task of making chicken pot pie, completely from scratch, in under 45 minutes. This is no BS! Dave enlists his buddy, Chris Ying, to help. The guys have nothing prepped, no plan, and no recipes. Dave’s gonna tackle the crust. Chris is gonna make the filling. The timer starts, and they’re off. WILL THEY MAKE IT HAPPEN?

programme.title: Cooking School
programme.desc: "Dave Chang makes BEER CAN CHICKEN the wrong way (and it’s so good)" - Two days after failing at his first ever Beer Can Chicken attempt, Dave gets right back on the horse. He’s committed to getting it right, keeping it simple, and making the white meat as delicious as the dark. Plus: he demonstrates a lazy man's beer pan sauce that will make you question ever doing things the “right” way again.

programme.title: Cooking School
programme.desc: "David Chang upgrades his Momofuku Sweet & Spicy Noodles (with a perfect fried egg!)" - Dave cooks up some of the Momofuku Sweet & Spicy Noodles and tricks them out with Korean dongchimi (pickled radish), kimchi and a—ahem—*perfectly* fried egg.

programme.title: Winning Mealtime
programme.desc: Winning Mealtime - Whole Roasted Chicken with Morgan McGlone: Our friend Morgan McGlone has cooked a lot of chicken—or "chook," as they call it in Australia, where he's from. He's a hell of a chef and restaurateur, as well as an excellent father to his son, Ryo. In this episode, he talks us through his roast chicken method, which, spoiler alert, involves a lot of butter. This is a bit of a long cook, so it's more of a weekend dish, but nothing beats breaking into a whole chicken with your family. The kids get to see food in its whole form, and pick the pices they want. The only decision you have to make is whether to share the best bits, or save them for yourself.

programme.title: Winning Mealtime
programme.desc: Winning Mealtime - Cantonese-Style Steamed Fish with Morgan McGlone: World-class Australian chef Morgan McGlone joins Chris Ying to share his go-to technique for preparing a whole steamed fish—something his son absolutely loves! A lot of people are intimidated by cooking a whole fish, but this is our plea to you to get your kids started on steaming/eating whole fish early in life!

programme.title: Winning Mealtime
programme.desc: Winning Mealtime - Japanese Curry Your Kids (and You!) Will Love: Chris Ying shares his recipe for a creamy, dreamy Japanese curry that uses milk and honey to hit all the right notes that kids love. If your kids already like curry...you're golden with this recipe! And if your kids are new to the curry game, this is the perfect introduction.

programme.title: Winning Mealtime
programme.desc: Winning Mealtime: Hacky Pad Thai for the Whole Family - This... is not pad thai. It has everything you love about pad thai—umami, sweetness, chewy rice noodles, brightness from lime—but this is the super hacky version I make for my wife and kids whenever I come across a package of fresh or semi-fresh noodles at the Asian market. If one of my Thai friends comes over, I'm hiding this from them. (If you're watching this, I'm sorry. It's all in the name of feeding the kids!) Ingredient-wise, you can keep tamarind and fish sauce in the fridge and pork belly in the freezer, but this recipe really depends on whether or not you have the noodles, which aren't available everywhere. You can use the dried kind, but I don't prefer them because they never seem to get to the right texture.

programme.title: Winning Mealtime
programme.desc: Winning Mealtime: Quick Chicken Piccata - So far, my kids have always happily eaten this chicken piccata. It's crispy, sweet, sour, and super savory thanks to those little capers (which are easy to pluck out if the kids don't want them). But the real win is that my wife is obsessed with this dish, too. Usually, I can have this on the table in under 25 minutes, start to finish, which is a huge win. Also, while I almost always prefer chicken thighs, this is one of the rare instances where white meat is just fine.

programme.title: Winning Mealtime
programme.desc: Winning Mealtime: Sweet & Sour Pork Ribs (aka "Kid McGear Bones") - Chris makes a go-to favorite for his kids—sticky, sweet and sour pork ribs in bite-sized portions.

programme.desc: In this episode we look at the WWF Responsible Fisheries Programme. Dr. Samantha Petersen, the programme manager, tells exactly us what this entails and Tali dons her waterproofs and sets sail where she chats to fishermen and others in the industry.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Bad blood between unwed parents leads to a fight over a three-year-old car accident and an attempt to collect far more than the car is worth. Jail time, alleged domestic violence and admitted drug use come into play.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: In a small Idaho farming community, a teenager sells four piglets to a neighbor and expects to be paid in full. The buyer claims all four animals died and that he owes nothing.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: An unlikely friendship develops between a male nurse and a female inmate through a prison pen pal program. Soon after her release, their once-supportive relationship devolves into a fight over stimulus checks and a car loan.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: What Not to Teach Your Teenager and Padding the Bill?
programme.desc: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, despite eye-witness testimony, a man insists that his unlicensed girlfriend was not driving his truck when it backed into a neighbor's house. His teenage son backs up his story. Next, a mechanic refuses to return a woman's wrecked car until he is paid; she admits to spending insurance money intended for car repairs on her own personal expenses.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A senior victim of bank fraud seeks restitution from her teenage, great granddaughter who made the mistake of accepting mysterious checks from an ex-con relative.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Teenagers who met in foster care get into a catfight over a boy. Their fight escalates into an aggressive act of caught-on-tape vandalism, an arrest and a 10K lawsuit.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Love Triangle Drama and Halloween Party Gone Wrong
programme.desc: Her Honor presides over two cases in this episode. First, a young woman breaks up with her live-in boyfriend and starts to date their new roommate. The ex-boyfriend sues the happy new couple for $10K and for the return of his two cats. Next, business partners pay $6K to rent a party space for teens; they sue for breach of contract when event restrictions are put in place without their approval.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A man is sued for alleged failure to pay his late mother's caregiver. He accuses the healthcare worker of contributing to the 'delinquency of an elderly patient' by giving his dying mother cigarettes and marijuana.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A 14-year-old girl steals her mother's car, goes on a joyride and T-bones an unsuspecting motorist on her way to work. The teenager runs from the crash site; the injured motorist leaves in an ambulance.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.sub-title: Teen Party Flood Damage and Inheritance Damages
programme.desc: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. Up first, while attending a friend's birthday party, a teenager accidentally breaks an outdoor sprinkler. Her actions, caught on security footage, cause $9K in flooding throughout an apartment building. In the next case, after inheriting her late brother's home, a woman triples the rent on his remaining tenant and sues him for alleged property damage.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: In this two-part episode, a woman who suffered abuse as a child is convinced her neighbor is guilty of neglect and reports her to DCS multiple times.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: In part two, the Judge must decide if a woman's allegations are justified as feuding neighbors sue for the 10k court maximum over an alleged assault and shocking charges of child endangerment.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: Former army buddies pool their resources to purchase one luxury vehicle in order to start a car rental business. A doomed rental ends with the vehicle being wrecked, their insurance being dropped and thousands in damage.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A young widow with a newborn baby claims her deceased husband’s best friend stole money from his account. The best friend defends his actions passionately and says the money went to a GoFundMe set up for his children.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: To make ends meet, young parents decide to sell their pets. They immediately regret their decision and fight for the return of one of their dogs.

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: To compensate for lost playing time during Covid, a devoted father pays a basketball coach $8500 to start up a team for his son. He sues for damages when the team falls apart.

programme.title: Judy Justice

programme.title: Judy Justice
programme.desc: A battle of bad online reviews is waged in rural Michigan between a pet daycare business and a water supply company.

programme.title: Judy Justice

programme.title: Judy Justice

programme.title: Judy Justice

programme.desc: The Judge rules on two cases in this episode. First, following an honorable discharge from the military, a teen seeks refuge with her aunt. programme.desc: Dethklok travels to the Amazon where they learn about native brutality from the Yannemango Indians.

programme.desc: William Murderface creates the "Nascar-type Theatrical Hybrid Event" and takes all creative and logistical control upon himself. Nathan and Pickles try to be supportive of their overwhelmed pal, while Skwisgaar and Toki attempt to get their driver licenses.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Nathan learns that his ex-girlfriend, Rebecca Nightrod, has already found new love while still in a coma, he decides to return to the dating scene. Unfortunately, the rest of the band makes it difficult for Nathan to make a true love connection.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The band is fed up with Offdenson knowing more than they do. They want their fifth of everything and decide to hire an efficiency expert to tighten up matters at Mordhaus and maximize their weekly allowance.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Toki gets news that his dad is dying, he's forced to travel back to his home town in Norway. The rest of the band decides to make a vacation out of it, citing "album inspiration" as their excuse to further put off working on their delayed album.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The world economy is crumbling and waiting for the next Dethklok album to stimulate it back into order. It's up to Dethklok to get the album just right and finished on time.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After the attack on Mordhaus, Dethklok is left without a manager and plagued by greedy record execs and forced to face the brutality of the slumping economy while dabbling in interior design. Will they spend everything and sign a deal that will render them powerless? Or worse, will they allow Murderface to turn the living room into an Arizona-styled sandscape?

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok joins their own Dethklok tribute band as a last ditch effort to connect with their rock and roll roots.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After a near-death experience, Dethklok realizes they would rather be sick and not know then face the brutality of going to a doctor. After home remedies including drinking bleach, Dethklok learns that their ultimate fear will be realized, one of them has a terminal illness. Meanwhile Nathan tries to brave the brutality of going to the dentist and Murderface faces the possibility of being gay after accidentally ejaculating on a doctors face. Part of Season 3.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok must experience the ultimate brutality of the Holiday season; spending time with their MOTHERS. Meanwhile Murderface ringleads the ultimate Christmas special that ends up being backed by the Christian church. And a particular ROCK AND ROLL clown makes a holiday appearance. Part of season 3.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After an onslaught of paternity suits, Skwisgaar realizes he will never change until he quits the band to find his father who abandoned him before birth.Meanwhile, Dethklok realizes they all have father abandonment issues and Murderface decides to repair the damages by appointing himself "Band Father."

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki falls head over heals for a girl he meets online. When things sour he tries to break it off and instead has to bear the brutality of being her date at her father's vegan funeral in 110 degree heat. Meanwhile Nathan experiences the brutality of dating a performance artist. And Murderface must attend a sexual harassment seminar after trying to match Skwisgaar's sexual prowess.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Murderface wants the easy life but still wants all the rewards. After the band decides to kick him out for making their jobs more difficult, Murderface realizes the EASIEST way to make BIG money is to start his own label.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Drunk driving HOVER DRUMS and causing billions in damage Pickles the drummer is thrown into rehab and his worst nightmares are realized when he is replaced- by a drum machine.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki tries to turn the life of his rock-and-roll clown friend, Dr. Rockzo, around by investing Dethklok's vacation fund. Everything goes smoothly until the media peers into Rockzo's past and discovers the clown's darkest secret.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: While Dethklok's manager, Charles Offdensen, is absent cleaning up hundreds of problems caused by the band, Dethklok double books a gig--between Syria and Israel on the same day.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Despite his bandmates' warnings, Nathan begins seriously dating one of his fans. But as the evidence of her past piles up, to prove her innocence, he follows her to the most brutal place on earth: Klokikon - the annual Dethklok fan convention filled with cosplay geeks and homosexual fan art. Meanwhile, the rest of the band starts smoking after Murderface lands the cover of Smokaroonie Aficionado.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Dethklok is accused of being racist at a huge press conference, they combat the charges by opening an Urban Youth Dethcenter. Meanwhile, Toki, after being left behind, starts a special club that promotes equality and love but excludes Murderface because he doesn't have the right look.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: With their new album finally shipping, Dethklok plans their post-release traditions of vacationing, goofing off, palling around, and prank calls. Nathan, however, can't shake the feeling that something is wrong with the record... After being humiliated by Murderface's prank calls, Skwisgaar and Toki swear revenge.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok heads to Tomahawk, Wisconsin to open a Dethfair in hopes that it will stimulate the economy they destroyed. Pickles uses this time at home to reconnect with his disapproving mother who tells him that she won't respect him until he gets a real job. Pickles decides to hang up his drumsticks and goes into an even more brutal profession: he becomes a realtor.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Tired of taking verbal abuse from his bandmate, Toki writes a tell-all book called Skwisgaar Is Ams Dick and takes over as Dethklok's lead guitarist. But can Toki handle the spotlight? Meanwhile, Nathan buys a new favorite toy for the band: a defibrillator.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After spending all their time with sluts and squandering the budget on their new record, Dethklok is shocked to find they've been assigned a new producer: A WOMAN. She sends them on a pre-writing vacation that turns out to be a brutal trip to a third world country where they're mistaken as women and captured as sex slaves.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In an effort to make friends, Toki goes to Rockaroonie Fantasy Camp - a weekend getaway to rub elbows with rock and roll royalty (but he attends as a camper.) Instead of meeting friends, he is bullied by other campers and has no one to turn to but celebrity counselor, Magnus Hammersmith; ex-Dethklok guitarist with a troubled past. With Toki - the diabetic scaredy cat - out of Mordhaus, Skwisgaar and Murderface act out and over do it with candy and scary movies.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After Murderface is announced as the recipient of this year's Most Brutal Looking Musician Award, he travels to Mexico to get the best and cheapest plastic surgery possible. Meanwhile, the rest of Dethklok deal with the brutality of aging and letting themselves go.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok returns to the water to record in their new Dethsub but, plagued with the lack of women, carpel tunnel sets in from excessive masturbation. The band regresses to an animal mindset. Pickles and Nathan spend their energy crossing the workplace relationship line and competing for the only woman on the sub: their producer.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: As Dethklok hosts the most important dinner of their career, the divvying of album credits, over tagging on social networking sites, and fights over a girl come to head. Can CFO keep their issues in check? Will the record executives forgive them for the past year of mistakes? Or will it be a total, brutal disaster?

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: While the world awaits the final Dethklok performance, members of the band prepare for their post-Dethklok careers. Pickles starts a winery for the most alcoholic wine ever, Nathan and Swkisgaar look for a brand new sound that doesn't suck, and Toki works with Murderface on his campaign for congressman. Meanwhile, Salacia takes Dethklok's weakness as the opportune time to strike!

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok is notified of a looming secret that's been around for hundreds of years: the secret of the Metalocalypse. Before they can contemplate what this means, however, Nathan must give a eulogy and do the most brutal thing he has ever done: get in touch with his emotions.

programme.desc: Will Dethklok find their lost bandmate Toki Wartooth? Find out in this hour long Rock Opera special featuring a 50 piece orchestra and special guests Mark Hamill, Malcolm McDowell, and Cannibal Corpse's George "Corpsegrinder" Fisher.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After performing a coffee jingle in the farthest reaches of the Arctic Circle to a sold-out crowd, Dethklok witnesses their French chef being chopped to pieces by the blade of their helicopter restaurant. programme.title: Metalocalypse

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The band plays a song that unintentionally wakes a deadly Nordic Forest Troll. programme.title: Metalocalypse
